job.title: Licensed Mental Health Clinician
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Licensed Mental Health Clinician for a contract assignment with a respected client located in Newark, NJ. The Clinician will deliver comprehensive behavioral health services to students, including intake assessments, individual and group therapy, crisis response services, and evaluations to assess mental health risks and support student well-being.

**NJ Applicable Licenses: LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or Licensed Psychologist

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 month contract with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $40-62/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Diagnoses and assesses counseling and treatment needs and conducts crisis assessments, interventions, and management for distressed students
  • Provides hands-on case management for on- and off-campus referrals, monitors students of concern, and participates in discharge planning
  • Requires knowledge and experience of psychotherapy, the ability to operate within systems, and the ability to develop a database of viable and appropriate mental health resources for various levels of care (e.g. outpatient, inpatient, intensive outpatient, etc)
  • Provides ethical and responsible treatment of students by prioritizing completing administrative tasks, including intake assessments, treatment plan reviews, progress notes, crisis notes, and discharge summaries
  • Engages with the campus community including providing outreach, consultation, and educational services as requested.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Master’s Degree in mental health discipline plus two (2) years post Master’s experience in the mental health field including delivering psychotherapeutic services to the identified population, or a Doctorate Degree.
  • Independent license to practice as required by New Jersey state laws governing the discipline (LPC, LCSW, LMFT, Licensed Psychologist).
What’s In It For You?
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities.
  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll
 
APPLY NOW!
Recruiter: Laura Mopas

job.title: AWS Workspaces Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AWS Workspaces Engineer
Location: Charlotte,NC
Terms: Full Time
Type: Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Position summary:
Our client is seeking a highly skilled Cloud Computing Engineer specializing in Amazon WorkSpaces to design, implement, optimize, and support our cloud-based virtual desktop environment. This role will serve as the primary technical owner for AWS WorkSpaces architecture, image management, automation, identity integration, security, monitoring, and platform operations.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across AWS WorkSpaces, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Windows endpoint management, cloud networking, automation, and authentication technologies. This individual will lead platform engineering efforts, establish operational standards, drive automation initiatives, support large-scale desktop deployments, and help evolve our virtual desktop strategy from traditional on-premises VDI solutions toward a modern cloud-based desktop platform.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical leadership, troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to independently own complex infrastructure initiatives from design through production support.

Key Responsibilities
AWS WorkSpaces Engineering & Architecture
  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale Amazon WorkSpaces environments.
  • Architect and manage AWS WorkSpaces deployments across multiple environments.
  • Develop long-term platform strategy, scalability planning, and operational standards.
  • Evaluate and implement new AWS EUC technologies and features.
  • Conduct capacity planning, performance analysis, and platform optimization.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery validation procedures.
  • Perform root cause analysis for complex platform-wide issues.
  • undefined
Image Management & Desktop Engineering
  • Build, maintain, and optimize AWS WorkSpaces custom images and bundles.
  • Create standardized gold images aligned with security and operational requirements.
  • Validate Windows updates, application patching, and security configurations before promotion to production.
  • Manage image lifecycle processes, testing procedures, rollback strategies, and release documentation.
  • Implement automation for image creation, validation, and deployment.
  • Ensure image consistency across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Establish desktop hardening standards and compliance baselines.
 
Identity, Directory Services & Authentication
  • Design and support integrations between AWS WorkSpaces, Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Manage AWS Directory Services and hybrid identity configurations.
  • Troubleshoot directory synchronization, computer object creation, OU placement, and authentication workflows.
  • Support hybrid identity solutions involving Active Directory, Entra Connect, and Intune.
  • Configure and maintain MFA integrations utilizing RADIUS authentication.
  • Lead initiatives to migrate legacy authentication methods toward SAML-based federation.
  • Support Single Sign-On solutions and modern authentication architectures.
 
Intune & Endpoint Management Integration
  • Partner with Endpoint Engineering teams to integrate AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Intune.
  • Ensure proper enrollment and management of hybrid-joined WorkSpaces devices.
  • Support application deployment, policy management, compliance enforcement, and reporting through Intune.
  • Troubleshoot device registration and management issues involving Entra ID and Intune.
  • Develop standards for cloud-hosted desktop management using Microsoft technologies.
  • Collaborate on endpoint security, patching, and configuration management initiatives.
 
Cloud Infrastructure & Networking
  • Administer AWS networking components supporting WorkSpaces environments.
  • Manage Route 53 DNS configurations and name resolution services.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, firewall, VPN, and DNS-related issues.
  • Work closely with network engineering teams to optimize cloud connectivity and user experience.
  • Understand VPC design, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, and routing principles as they relate to WorkSpaces deployments.
  • Support desktop access from Windows, macOS, thin clients, and mobile platforms.
 
Automation & Platform Engineering
  • Develop automation solutions utilizing AWS Lambda, PowerShell, Python, and AWS native services.
  • Automate provisioning, monitoring, remediation, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Create self-healing mechanisms for common platform issues.
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code standards where applicable.
  • Reduce operational overhead through orchestration and automation initiatives.
 
Monitoring & Operational Excellence
  • Configure and maintain CloudWatch dashboards, metrics, alarms, and logging.
  • Develop proactive monitoring and alerting capabilities.
  • Analyze performance trends and resource utilization.
  • Implement operational reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Participate in incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Drive continuous service improvements and platform optimization efforts.
 
Security & Compliance
  • Ensure AWS WorkSpaces environments meet security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and monitoring.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and platform hardening initiatives.
  • Participate in audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Maintain secure access standards, least privilege permissions, and identity governance controls.
  • Support logging, monitoring, and security event investigations.
 
Operational Requirements
  • Execute infrastructure changes under strict Change Management procedures.
  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and support guides.
  • Participate in after-hours maintenance activities as required.
  • Provide Level 3 engineering support and escalation assistance.
  • Collaborate across cloud, infrastructure, security, networking, and endpoint management teams.
  
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of AWS engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of Amazon WorkSpaces administration and architecture experience.
  • Deep understanding of AWS WorkSpaces Images, Bundles, Directories, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.
  • Experience integrating AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Entra ID and Intune.
  • Experience supporting RADIUS MFA authentication and SAML federation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts including Route 53, DNS, VPCs, subnets, routing, and security controls.
  • Experience with AWS CloudWatch monitoring and alerting.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation experience.
  • Experience utilizing AWS Lambda for operational automation.
  • Knowledge of endpoint deployment and application delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting Windows 11 enterprise desktop environments.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Estimated Max Rate: $120000.00

job.title: Email Marketing Manager-Salesforce
job.description:
Job Title: Email Marketing Manager
Location: New York City
Terms: Hybrid( 3 days onsite)
Pay Rate: : $60-$63/hr
Type: Contract to Perm

Reporting Relationships:
As our Email Marketing Manager, you will report to our Email & Marketing Automation Lead, who reports to our Head of Owned Channels.



We’re seeking a results-driven Email Marketing and Automation Manager with deep Salesforce Marketing Cloud expertise to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of email marketing programs using Stensul, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and AMPscript.

You are:
• A successful B2B and B2C Marketer with deep email marketing experience who thrives in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment. You are well-organized?and have a collaborative and flexible personality who adapts easily to change
• Experienced in managing email campaigns in both the Pardot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform, including setup, testing, deployment, and reporting.
• Responsible for management of internal stakeholders, acting as an internal email consultant on email marketing best practices
• A strong partner. You will be partnering with enterprise, product, field, enrollment, and content marketing to optimize email content, scheduling, deployment, and automation
• Comfortable with subject matter experts, executives, and peers. You can collaborate across departments to transform conceptual thinking into executable insights and inform customer segmentation opportunities and create useful sales enablement tools
• A clear, concise written and verbal communicator.

You have:
• A bachelor’s degree.
• A minimum of 5 years of B2B or B2C email marketing experience.
• Experience working with email marketing and marketing automation platforms, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud (preference for also having Pardot experience).
• Experience managing stakeholders or clients internally or in an agency environment.
• The ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
• The ability to think critically and make optimization decisions based on data and analytics.
• A demonstrated understanding of email marketing best practices, testing, data analysis, reporting, deliverability, and compliance.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present to technical and non-technical audiences.
• A willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.
• Experience with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

You will:
• Build and deploy email marketing campaigns across a variety of audiences, products, and platforms in support of business objectives.
• Manage email campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including setup, testing, deployment, and reporting.
• Design, build, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys using Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and Contact Builder.
• Create and maintain audience segments using SQL Query Activities, Filter Activities, and Data Extensions.
• Develop triggered communications based on customer behaviors, CRM events, and business rules.
• Leverage dynamic content, personalization, decision splits, and audience targeting to deliver relevant customer experiences.
• Understand Einstein capabilities and best practices for using it for journey sends
• Partner with stakeholders and serve as an internal consultant on email marketing best practices.
• Collaborate across marketing teams to optimize email content, scheduling, deployment, and automation.
• Think strategically to prioritize projects and execute email marketing campaigns that support short- and long-term goals.
• Establish email marketing best practices and support automation strategies that improve channel performance and efficiency.
• Practice best in class QA. Follow and improve internal processes and execute with strong attention to detail.
• Provide clear campaign results against goals and relevant benchmarks.
• Assess email performance and make recommendations for improvement.
• Ensure clear, timely communication of relevant email marketing activities and collect stakeholder feedback.

job.title: Senior Identity Access Management Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior IAM Engineer
Location: Holmdel, NJ- Hybrid( 3 days onsite)
Type: Full time 
Salary: $140000- $160000/yr 


The Senior IAM Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and handling identity and access management (IAM) solutions to ensure the security and efficiency of the organization's IT infrastructure. This role involves working closely with various groups to understand their IAM needs and providing expert guidance on standard methodologies and solutions.
 
You Will:

  • Design and implement IAM solutions, including identity governance, access management, and privileged access management.
  • Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with IT and security teams to integrate IAM solutions with existing systems and applications.
  • Conduct regular audits and assessments of IAM systems to identify and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in IAM and recommend improvements to existing systems and processes.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior IAM engineers and other team members.

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in IAM engineering or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of IAM concepts, technologies, and standard processes.
  • Experience with IAM platforms, including Okta, PingFederate, SailPoint, CyberArk, and Microsoft Azure AD/Entra ID.
  • Experience with reverse proxy solutions, including Okta Access Gateway and Microsoft App Proxy.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or similar are a plus.
  • Passion for problem-solving and continuous curiosity to learn.
  • Understanding of security control concepts and their application in IAM.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

You Are:
  • Experience with cloud-based IAM solutions and integrations.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and standards related to IAM, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and AWS.
  • Experience with scripting and automation tools to streamline IAM processes.

job.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React and C#/.NET Core)
job.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Location: Irving, TX
Schedule: 4 days onsite / 1 day remote

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join a growing technology team. This role is ideal for a seasoned developer who remains highly hands-on and enjoys contributing to both application development and higher-level technical decisions.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience across the full stack, particularly with React, JavaScript, C#, and .NET Core, along with a strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.

What You'll Do
  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using C#/.NET Core, React, and JavaScript
  • Make and communicate architectural and technical design decisions
  • Apply object-oriented programming principles and software design patterns
  • Evaluate different technical approaches and explain the reasoning behind architectural decisions
  • Develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality software across the application stack
  • Collaborate with other developers and technical stakeholders on application design and implementation
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and contribute to long-term solutions
  • Continue writing production-quality code while providing senior-level technical guidance
What We're Looking For
  • Approximately 15+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong, recent hands-on development experience
  • Strong proficiency with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with React and JavaScript
  • Solid full-stack development background
  • Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and software architecture
  • Ability to explain the reasoning behind technical and architectural decisions
  • Experience designing and developing scalable applications
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, onsite environment
Important Details
  • 4 days per week onsite in Irving, TX with 1 remote day
  • Candidates must be comfortable remaining hands-on with development
  • A mandatory onsite technical interview is part of the process

job.title: BSA/Product Owner
job.description:
Job Title: Business Systems Analyst/Product Owner
Location: Plano, TX (Hybrid – Onsite 3 Days/Week)
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Work Authorization: W2 Only (No C2C)

Responsibilities:
  • Define, document, and prioritize business, system, and product requirements aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
  • Lead requirement-gathering efforts, including JAD sessions, with stakeholders to ensure shared understanding and alignment across business and technology teams.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of business processes and system capabilities to ensure requests align with operational constraints and best practices.
  • Serve as the liaison between internal/external stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring clear, timely, and positive communication.
  • Create and manage a structured product backlog with well-crafted user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization.
  • Own and refine the product vision and roadmap, adjusting strategy based on market trends, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
  • Conduct gap analyses between current system functionality and new business requirements, collaborating closely with architects and developers.
  • Partner with Project Managers to support end-to-end project delivery, from planning through release.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Daily Stand-ups, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that deliverables meet business and functional expectations.
  • Effectively manage competing priorities using strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies to help guide product and process improvements.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business systems analysis or related roles, including 3+ years in Agile environments.
  • Proven experience in business requirements gathering, process documentation, and gap analysis.
  • Skilled in writing clear and actionable user stories, business requirements, and managing product backlogs.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into technical specifications and product features.
  • Proficient in tools such as Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across levels.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Capable of thriving in both team-driven and independent work environments.

job.title: Desktop Support Technician
job.description:
Desktop Support Specialist
Contract to hire
Irving, TX (Onsite)
 
Seeking a Desktop Support Technician to support and maintain all aspects of the Service Center's systems and employees. This will include but not be limited to face-to-face interaction with users, hardware and software tasks, onsite end-user support, and configuration support of Windows operating systems. The successful candidate will display excellent customer service skills and quick decision making to identify and resolve technical inquiries as well as perform various technical and support tasks as assigned.
 
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience installing, configuring, troubleshooting and repairing computers and applications in a domain environment
  • Possess a passion for providing excellent customer service
  • Knowledge of installing, configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting Windows and Apple computers.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Office products including O365/Active Directory.
  • Active Directory administration experience.
  • Working knowledge of anti-virus, anti-spam applications.
  • Experience working with Help Desk ticketing systems.
  • Installation and support of video conferencing (AV) equipment.
  • Eagerness and ability to learn other hardware and software as they become pertinent to the business needs.
  • Proven troubleshooting skills.
  • Management and support of VPN access accounts.
  • Basic understanding of networking.
  • Extensive knowledge of computer applications and conceptually, how they work.
  • Organizational skills sufficient to ensure all calls are logged and follow-up is complete.
  • Ability to answer telephones and provide courteous, prompt and efficient customer service.
  • Ability to organize multiple tasks and prioritize them to meet specific deadlines.
  • Confidence to interact with a wide range of people from clerical staff, network specialists, developers, senior management, and vendors
  • Physical qualifications required to perform the job function include the ability to lift 20 lbs. as well as to sit for long periods of time.
  • Proficiency to read, write and communicate orally the English language, especially IT technical terms and concepts.
  • Advanced math skills including: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, ratios, discounts/multipliers and probabilities.
  • Ability to use Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Competence to set up and operate a personal computer, printers and external computer peripherals.

job.description:
Corporate Paralegal (Energy Industry Experience) needed for a HYBRID contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $35-45/hr
  • HYBRID-onsite occasionally/as-needed
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Paralegal will support  legal & compliance efforts by preparing documents and filings, provide support for activities related to drafting, processing, updating and filing tariff and tariff related agreements; provide support for all activities surrounding or relative to the drafting and processing of agreements and other legal documents as well as the coordination of assignments and workflow for attorneys. Additionally, the Paralegal will conduct legal and factual research; execute filings; facilitate legal and compliance matters; and act as a liaison among various internal departments as well as outside agencies.
  • Provide legal support for counsel in the stakeholder process, and in litigation and regulatory proceedings both at the state and federal levels.

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Quality Control Inspector to join our medical device client in Lewisville, TX. This opportunity is ideal for candidates with hands-on quality inspection experience who are comfortable reading technical drawings, performing dimensional inspections, and working within a regulated manufacturing environment. This is an onsite position, requiring the completion of a background check and standard drug screen. 

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Quality Control Inspector
Location: Lewisville, TX – Onsite
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00am-7:00pm (some flexibility) 
Compensation: $26.00–$29.00/hour, depending on experience
Type: Contract
 

Responsibilities
  • Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of materials, components, subassemblies, and finished products.

  • Review engineering drawings, inspection instructions, sampling requirements, and workmanship standards to verify product conformance.

  • Perform dimensional and visual inspections using tools such as calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, and electronic test equipment.

  • Maintain accurate quality and receiving inspection records and enter inspection data into applicable systems.

  • Identify and document nonconforming materials and support discrepancy reporting and resolution activities.

  • Complete inventory and product transactions within Oracle, including product acceptance, delivery, and BOM-related activities.

  • Prepare or support quality documentation such as inspection procedures, engineering change documentation, and discrepancy reports.

  • Assist with training and providing guidance to less-experienced inspectors.

  • Prioritize inspection activities based on production and operational requirements.

  • Participate in problem-solving efforts and recommend opportunities to improve product quality and inspection processes.

  • Follow applicable FDA, ISO, safety, quality system, and company requirements.

Qualifications
  • 2+ years of Quality Control/Quality Inspection experience, preferably within medical device, manufacturing, or another regulated environment.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection principles.

  • Hands-on experience using calipers, micrometers, and other precision measuring equipment.

  • Ability to independently perform a variety of quality inspection activities and appropriately prioritize workload.

  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience supporting or training junior inspectors is preferred.

  • Experience with Oracle or a similar ERP/manufacturing system is a plus.

  • High school diploma or equivalent is preferred but not required.

  • Ability to regularly stand, walk, sit, bend, and reach throughout the workday and frequently lift, carry, or move items weighing up to 40 lbs., with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Visual acuity, with correction if needed, sufficient to perform required dimensional, cosmetic, and workmanship inspections.

job.title: SAFETY ENGINEERING - PHOENIX, AZ
job.description:
Safety Representative - Applied Materials at TSMC Phoenix, AZ | $33 - $38 /Hour | Monday-Friday Dayshift | No Travel Help protect the people who power the semiconductor industry.

Yoh is hiring a Safety Representative to support Applied Materials at the world-renowned TSMC semiconductor facility in Phoenix, Arizona. This is a unique opportunity for safety professionals who enjoy being in the field, engaging directly with employees, identifying hazards before incidents occur, and serving as a visible safety leader in a high-tech manufacturing environment.

If you're tired of sitting behind a desk and want a hands-on role where you can make an immediate impact every day, we want to hear from you.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out ? Competitive Pay: $33 - $38 per hour

? Stable Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM

? Work with Industry Leaders: Support Applied Materials at one of the most advanced semiconductor facilities in North America

? Make a Difference: Protect employees and help drive a world-class safety culture

? Modern Cleanroom Environment

? High Visibility Role with Significant Impact

What You'll Be Doing As a Safety Representative, you will serve as the "boots-on-the-ground" safety expert supporting Applied Materials engineers working inside the TSMC fabrication facility.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Maintaining a strong daily field presence within the fab
  • Performing safety audits and inspections
  • Identifying hazards and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensuring compliance with OSHA, TSMC, and Applied Materials safety standards
  • Reviewing work permits, PPE requirements, and safe work procedures
  • Supporting safe execution of high-risk work activities
  • Coaching employees and subcontractors on safe work practices
  • Documenting findings and communicating safety concerns to leadership
  • Stopping work when unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed
  • Participating in daily engineering team pass-down meetings
This role requires spending significant time in the cleanroom and being comfortable walking and standing throughout the day.

What We're Looking For Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in industrial, manufacturing, semiconductor, construction, or related environments
  • OSHA 30-Hour Certification (Construction or General Industry) with proof of completion
  • Strong hazard recognition and risk mitigation skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Comfortable spending 6+ hours per day in a cleanroom environment
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
Preferred Qualifications
  • 2+ years of safety experience within manufacturing, construction, or semiconductor environments
  • EHS Certification:
    • CHST
    • OHST
    • ASP
    • GSP
  • OSHA 510 or OSHA 511
  • Science-related degree
  • Semiconductor industry experience
Ideal Backgrounds We encourage applications from:

  • Safety Technicians
  • Safety Coordinators
  • EHS Specialists
  • EHS Technicians
  • Construction Safety Representatives
  • Manufacturing Safety Professionals
  • Semiconductor Safety Personnel
  • Industrial Hygienists
  • Military Safety Professionals
  • Environmental Health & Safety Professionals
Location TSMC Facility Suite 128 25800 N Norterra Pkwy Phoenix, AZ 85085

Work Environment: 100% On-Site

About Yoh Yoh has specialized in connecting talented professionals with leading employers for more than 80 years. As a Yoh consultant, you'll have access to competitive compensation, weekly pay, medical benefits, 401(k), employee assistance programs, and a dedicated recruiter committed to your success.

Apply Today! If you're passionate about workplace safety, enjoy being in the field, and want to support one of the world's most advanced manufacturing environments, apply now and become part of the team helping keep Applied Materials employees safe every day.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - GLOUCESTER, MA
job.description:
ELECTRO MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER OR Manufacturing Technician
Gloucester, MA

Schedule: 
  • Competitive pay ranging from $23.00 to $28.00 per hour, plus shift differentials
  • First Shift:  from 5 am to 3:30 pm Monday through Thursday
  • Second Shift:  from 3 on to 11:30 pm Monday through Thursday has an additional 10% differential 
  • Mid Shift:  from 11 am to 7 pm 
  • Third Shift:  from 7:30 pm to  6 am Monday through Thursday has an additional 13% differential 
  • Fourth Shift:  from 6 am to 6:30 pm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday with an additional 11% differential 
Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting-edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies
Working from work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal or written instructions
Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors
Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies
Entering production data, labor details, and work progress into computer systems
Receiving and auditing parts to ensure build readiness; inspecting components for defects
Troubleshooting issues and contributing to process improvements
Documenting completed work clearly and accurately
Safety & Work Environment

job.title: Sr. Network Security Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Network Security Engineer to join our advanced technology client. This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on securing and scaling complex enterprise network environments, with a strong emphasis on Palo Alto Networks, firewall architecture, network segmentation, VPN/security connectivity, and network automation.

The team is primarily targeting candidates in the San Mateo, CA area, with Washington, D.C. also a strong preferred location. Candidates near Santa Clarita or San Diego, CA, and Frisco, TX may also be considered. The position offers some flexibility in work arrangement depending on location and business needs, with occasional travel potentially required.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Network Security Engineer
Location: San Mateo, CA preferred; Washington, D.C. also strongly considered; additional locations may include Santa Clarita, CA; San Diego, CA; and Frisco, TX
Type: Contract
Compensation: $70-105/hr DOE 
Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder (ITAR / CUI environment)
 

Responsibilities
  • Engineer and support secure network infrastructure across corporate offices, data centers, remote locations, and cloud-connected environments.

  • Configure, administer, and enhance Palo Alto Networks technologies, including PAN-OS, Panorama, GlobalProtect, threat protection, application controls, and related security capabilities.

  • Manage firewall rules, network segmentation, NAT, site-to-site and remote-access VPNs, and secure connectivity solutions.

  • Support network access controls, authentication technologies, and Zero Trust/SASE initiatives.

  • Investigate network traffic, security events, connectivity issues, and vulnerabilities while assisting with remediation and incident response.

  • Perform firewall upgrades, configuration hardening, lifecycle maintenance, and production changes.

  • Troubleshoot complex routing, switching, WAN, wireless, firewall, application-access, and performance issues.

  • Support secure network connectivity between enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments, including AWS and Azure.

  • Collaborate with network, cloud, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams on architecture and technical implementations.

  • Develop automation for network and security operations using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Bash.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, configuration standards, and operational runbooks.

  • Provide senior-level escalation support for critical network and security incidents.

  • Participate in planned maintenance, on-call support, and technical knowledge sharing with other engineers.

Qualifications
  • 6+ years of professional experience supporting network security within complex enterprise or production environments.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks, particularly PAN-OS and Panorama.

  • Strong understanding of firewalls, segmentation, NAT, VPN technologies, threat prevention, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.

  • Experience working with enterprise networking platforms such as Juniper, Cisco, or Arista.

  • Hands-on experience with network automation or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Bash.

  • Ability to independently lead technical initiatives and resolve complex, business-critical network and security problems.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Palo Alto GlobalProtect, Prisma Access, Cloud NGFW, SASE, and/or Zero Trust architectures.

  • Experience administering Juniper routing and switching technologies.

  • Familiarity with Network Access Control solutions such as Aruba ClearPass or Mist Access Assurance.

  • Knowledge of 802.1X, RADIUS, certificate-based authentication, and enterprise wireless environments.

  • Experience supporting AWS and/or Azure networking.

  • Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCNP Enterprise, JNCIS/JNCIP, or comparable credentials.

  • Previous experience supporting regulated, mission-critical, aerospace, defense, or highly technical engineering environments.

In this vital role, you will maintain high-pressure equipment, deliver exceptional customer communication, and strictly prioritize safety and environmental compliance.

Duration: Direct Hire

job.title: Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer
job.description:
Job Title:Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer 
Location: Charlotte, NC
Type: Hybrid- 3 days onsite
Terms: Full Time


Position summary:
Our client is seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Microsoft 365 Communication Systems Engineer to join our Corporate Platform Engineering team. This role emphasizes Exchange administration (on-prem and cloud), Microsoft Teams management, and M365 governance, with strong knowledge of Purview retention policies and Defender for Cloud. The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded M365/Entra/Azure engineer who can troubleshoot complex issues, drive adoption of integrated SaaS solutions (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow in Teams), and maintain a secure, compliant environment.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Exchange Administration
  • Manage and maintain Exchange Online and on-prem Exchange environments, including mail flow, hybrid configurations, and security hardening.
  • Implement and maintain Exchange Online Protection (EOP) and Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, Safe Links, and Safe Attachments.
  • Troubleshoot mail delivery, transport rules, and compliance issues.
  • Manage mail routing, transport rules, connectors, accepted domains, DKIM, DMARC, SPF, and hybrid mail flow configurations.
  • Administer shared mailboxes, resource mailboxes, distribution groups, Microsoft 365 Groups, and mail-enabled security groups.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of mail flow, hybrid connectivity, directory synchronization, transport services, message trace analysis, and client connectivity issues.
 
Microsoft Teams Management
  • Configure and maintain Teams governance, policies, lifecycle management, external access, guest access, and collaboration settings.
  • Drive adoption of Teams integrations with SaaS platforms like Jira and ServiceNow.
  • Support Teams Phone, Auto Attendants, and Call Queues where applicable.
  • Support Teams Rooms and meeting experience enhancements.
 
Compliance & Security
  • Partner with Information Security teams to support Microsoft Purview retention, compliance, and information governance initiatives across Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online.
  • Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting, and platform expertise related to retention policies, compliance configurations, data lifecycle management, and Microsoft 365 workloads.
  • Participate in security reviews, audits, and remediation efforts supporting regulatory and
  • Job Title: M365 Engineer (Communications) Department: Operations & Technology Reports to: Director, Corporate Platform Engineering FLSA Status: Exempt Classification: Contract to hire
  • industry standards.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on Microsoft 365 security initiatives, providing expertise on Exchange Online, Teams, Entra ID, and related collaboration technologies.
  • Assist with Entra ID administration as needed, including enterprise application integration, SaaS application authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Conditional Access policy support.
 
Core Infrastructure Skill
  • Perform basic engineering tasks: Active Directory, Group Policy, schema updates, and certificate renewals.
  • Utilize monitoring tools for proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Automate tasks using PowerShell for M365 and Azure environments.
 
Operational Requirements
  • Execute after-hours changes as needed under strict Change Management processes.
  • Document configurations, troubleshooting steps, and knowledge transfer materials.
  • Collaborate across teams to efficiently identify issues, resolve problems, and continuously improve platform stability and user experience.
 
Qualifications
  • Deep expertise in Exchange Online and on-prem Exchange administration.
  • Experience troubleshooting mail flow, hybrid Exchange environments, transport services, connectors, and message delivery issues.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Teams governance, lifecycle management, and SaaS integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Experience supporting and troubleshooting Microsoft Purview compliance, retention, and information governance solutions.
  • Familiarity with Exchange Online Protection (EOP), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and email security best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Single Sign-On (SSO), Conditional Access, and hybrid identity solutions including Microsoft Entra Connect.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Solid understanding of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificate management, and hybrid identity architectures.
  • Experience with network and server administration fundamentals.
  • Knowledge of general disaster recovery validation methods and willingness to assist in testing efforts.
  • Comfortable working within a strict, heavily vetted Change Management process.
  • Ability to support security, audit, and risk control requirements within a regulated environment, with familiarity in common industry security frameworks.
  • Strong documentation skills for platform configurations and user instructions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.
  • Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills; able to clearly articulate initiatives and solutions.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and capable of adapting quickly to changing business and technology requirements.

job.title: IT/Financial Analyst
job.description:
IT/Financial Analyst
12+ month contract
Plano, TX (Hybrid)

Need a balance of IT Fincial portfolio management, procurement workflows, contract administration, and vendor-spend oversight.
Managing technology portfolios, project budgets, resources, vendors, and financial controls.
  • IT and Digital budget planning
  • Project labor, contractor, and professional-services costs
  • Onshore/offshore resource analysis
  • CapEx and OpEx management
  • Accruals, prepaid expenses, journal entries, and month-end close
  • Purchase orders and vendor spend
  • Contract renewals and license audits
  • Technology business cases, ROI, and investment analysis
  • SAP Ariba, Oracle, Coupa, Essbase, and advanced Excel
  • IT and Engineering financial support
  • Vendor contracts, renewals, and RFPs
  • SAP Ariba and Procure-to-Pay processes
  • Purchase orders and vendor pricing
  • Contract repositories and sourcing support
  • Labor and headcount analysis
  • Budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and amortization
  • Business cases, ROI, and investment analysis
  • Technology-project financial modeling
  • Reporting automation and process improvement

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Partner with  leadership to develop business cases and financial analyses for new initiatives, including ROI and value calculations; track and report results on a quarterly basis.
  • Serve as a liaison between project teams and A&F to support month-end close, financial forecasting, and budget-planning activities.
  • Assist with the month-end close process by preparing and reviewing accruals and ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial reporting.
  • Conduct financial analysis, including variance explanations, vendor comparisons, cost-savings opportunities, and onshore/offshore resource-mix analysis.
  • Support the development and ongoing data quality of the DI Hub project-management tool, which brings financial reporting, resource management, and contract management into a single application.
  • Submit and monitor product-team contracts in Ariba, and track related purchase orders, budget spend, and upcoming renewals to support timely processing, compliance, and effective financial management.
  • Maintain accurate team rosters and coordinate onboarding requests to support a smooth new-hire experience.

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Two or more years of experience in financial analysis, finance operations, project financial management, or a related role; experience in a technology or product-focused environment is preferred.
  • Experience supporting financial planning and analysis activities, including forecasting, budgeting, month-end close, accruals, and variance analysis.
  • Ability to develop business cases and financial models that support investment decisions, new initiatives, and portfolio planning.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify and communicate risks, trends, cost-saving opportunities, vendor comparisons, and resource-mix insights.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, data analysis, reporting, and budget tracking.
  • Experience managing contracts, purchase orders, and renewals; familiarity with procurement systems such as Ariba.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, financial reporting integrity, and process compliance.

job.title: Lending System Analyst
job.description:
As a Lending System Analyst, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring our clients new loan platform supports the seamless delivery of consumer loans, directly impacting millions of customers and supporting the future growth of their lending operations.

Overview
We’re seeking a knowledgeable and collaborative Lending System Analyst to serve as the business-side expert during the implementation of our new loan platform, This role is designed for someone with hands-on experience in consumer lending within banking or credit unions who understands the intricacies of the loan lifecycle—from origination to collections. Work remotely across time zones with a dynamic team dedicated to operational excellence and innovative financial solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the business-side technical project manager and platform steward for the new lending system, supporting configuration, workflow setup, testing, and launch.
  • Support and maintain loan product parameters, including loan terms, payment rules, and eligibility criteria to ensure regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—Product, Operations, IT, Legal & Compliance, Customer Care—to gather requirements, document processes, and translate needs into system capabilities.
  • Partner with external vendors to manage configuration, testing, defect resolution, and platform enhancements.
  • Manage user access, roles, permissions, and support processes to align with security and compliance standards.
  • Lead or assist in system testing, including user acceptance testing and defect triage, ensuring a smooth transition during platform go-live and post-launch stabilization.
  • Troubleshoot platform issues, research root causes, and coordinate resolutions across teams and vendors.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of system configurations, change history, and operational processes.
  • Support operational workflows such as payments, account updates, collections, and reporting, ensuring the platform supports audit and compliance needs.
  • Monitor platform performance, identify opportunities for improvements, and help implement automation or enhancements for scalable support.
Must-Have Requirements

  • Strong experience supporting consumer lending, loan servicing, or related financial services at banks or credit unions.
  • Deep knowledge of lending terminology, principles of principal and interest, and the loan lifecycle through collections.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with cross-functional teams, vendors, and leadership.
  • Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to research issues and recommend practical solutions.
Bring your expertise in consumer lending and become a key contributor to  innovative lending initiatives. Apply now to be part of a forward-thinking team dedicated to delivering excellence in financial services!

job.description:
Title::  Desktop Support Engineer
Location:  Jersey City, NJ
Type: Hybrid ( 3 days onsite)
Terms - 3 Months Contract to Hire
Pay Rate:  $50/hr-$55/hr
Salary: $95K-$120K base+ 10% Bonus
                  

The team is looking to add a Level 2/Level 3 Desktop Support Engineerto support a rapidly growing user base that has more than doubled over the past year.
The role is heavily focused on supporting Windows 11 laptops, Citrix-hosted VDI, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365.

The individual will serve as the primary point of contact for endpoint issues, troubleshoot problems, perform deployments, onboard and offboard users, and escalate infrastructure issues to specialized teams when necessary.

job.title: General Counsel, Construction-Long Island City NY
job.description:
Job Title:  General Counsel, Construction
Location: Long Island City, NJ
Fulltime Perm position
Position Overview:
We are seeking a business leader that brings a legal focus to strategic planning for
the General Counsel role to join our team. This position provides comprehensive legal
guidance across all business areas, ensuring compliance, protecting the company’s
interests, and enabling informed decision-making at both the leadership and project levels.
Your expertise in construction law, labor matters, contracts, and corporate governance will
help drive operational efficiency, mitigate risk, and support client's continued success.
Key Responsibilities:
• Advise executive leadership and project teams on legal rights, responsibilities, and
potential risks across all business operations.
• Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including owner agreements,
subcontractor agreements, vendor contracts, joint ventures, NDAs, and professional
services agreements.
• Assist with various claims (General Liability, Construction Defect, Subcontractor
Defaults, etc.) as necessary
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including construction,
employment, safety (OSHA), environmental, procurement, and licensing
requirements.
• Oversee corporate governance, including board matters, entity management,
insurance, and risk assessment.
• Oversee and manage the company’s portfolio of legal matters handled by outside
counsel, including litigation, claims, employment matters, regulatory issues, and
specialized transactional work.
• Develop and implement legal policies, internal controls, risk-mitigation strategies,
and training programs for staff.
• Manage legal aspects related to union labor matters, including collective bargaining
agreements, grievance procedures, and compliance with labor laws affecting
electricians and field personnel.
• Lead or support legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic
joint ventures, including target evaluation, due diligence, and legal risk assessment,
as well as negotiating key transaction documents
• Support HR on training, safety incidents, and compliance with apprenticeship and
licensing requirements for electrical workers.
• Manage relationships with external counsel, insurers, regulatory agencies, and other
stakeholders.
Qualifications:
• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school; active bar admission in good
standing.
• 10+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably with significant exposure to the
construction or real estate development industries.
• Strong background in contract negotiation, risk management, construction law, and
dispute resolution.
• Prior involvement in M&A activities, including due diligence, risk assessment, and
negotiation of transaction documents.
• Familiarity with union labor (IBEW or similar), collective bargaining agreements, and
prevailing wage requirements.
• Experience managing and coordinating outside counsel across litigation, claims, and
specialized legal matters
• Exceptional analytical abilities, communication skills, and business judgment.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and business-partnering abilities.
• Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and support both field and corporate
teams.

job.title: Workday Platform & Governance Owner - Workday SME
job.description:
Join a dynamic team leading the evolution of enterprise HR technology as our  client's Workday Platform & Governance Owner — the go-to expert shaping how thousands of employees experience HR systems every day. If you thrive on aligning complex systems with strategic business goals, this role offers a unique opportunity to impact our global workforce while advancing your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment.

Job Details:

Duration: Direct Hire- Permanent W2
Location: 3x a week onsite New York,NY, Holmdel NJ or Stamford CT
Pay Rate: $180k- $220k base


Overview

As the Workday SME and Governance Owner, you’ll serve as the enterprise technical authority across all Workday modules, ensuring our platform remains secure, compliant, and architecturally optimized. You’ll lead critical governance processes, oversee environment management, and provide expert configuration support for complex cross-functional initiatives—all while mentoring your team and collaborating with HRIT engineers and security partners.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the senior technical authority for all Workday modules, advising on complex configuration, integration, and release management.
  • Configure and support advanced security frameworks, eligibility rules, and cross-departmental business processes.
  • Lead tenant management efforts, including environment planning, sandbox refreshes, change approvals, and release cycles.
  • Oversee all governance activities, establishing standards for change management, audit compliance, and security protocols.
  • Chair the Workday Change Advisory Board, ensuring thorough review and smooth implementation of upgrades and enhancements.
  • Partner with security and audit teams to monitor and remediate access controls and segregation of duties issues.
Must-Have Qualifications
  • 7–10 years of HRIS experience, with 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration expertise.
  • Workday Pro Certifications across all major modules.
  • Deep knowledge of Position and Job Management, security architecture, and SOD audit controls.
  • Experience operating within a multi-tenant governance environment.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Expertise in integrations, APIs, and advanced configuration design.
  • Strong leadership in change management and vendor collaboration.

job.title: Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Equipment
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Equipment for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This is a hands-on manufacturing-floor engineering role supporting automated equipment and processes within a fast-paced cGMP sterile drug-product operation. The Process Engineer will own manufacturing-equipment troubleshooting, recurring-failure elimination, reliability and process improvements, performance monitoring, and implementation of new equipment, products, and manufacturing processes.

This position is best suited for an engineer who has personally supported production equipment, diagnosed equipment or process failures, implemented engineering changes, and demonstrated measurable improvements in reliability, quality, throughput, yield, or downtime. This is not a validation-only, quality-assurance, documentation, or continuous-improvement-only position.

What You Will Do
  • Provide hands-on engineering support for automated manufacturing equipment and production processes.
  • Troubleshoot recurring equipment and process failures, determine root causes, and implement sustainable corrective engineering solutions.
  • Lead equipment-reliability and process-improvement initiatives that improve uptime, throughput, yield, quality, scrap, cycle time, or other manufacturing KPIs.
  • Establish, monitor, and trend process and equipment performance metrics to identify reliability and performance opportunities.
  • Evaluate, design, modify, and implement manufacturing processes and equipment for existing and new products.
  • Support installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational handoff of new or modified manufacturing equipment.
  • Support new-product introductions, technology transfers, and manufacturing-line implementation.
  • Lead structured root-cause investigations involving manufacturing processes and equipment.
  • Author and support deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, engineering protocols, technical reports, and other controlled documentation associated with equipment and process changes.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, Maintenance, Automation, Technical Services, R&D, and other functions to implement compliant engineering improvements.
  • Support troubleshooting and diagnostic activities involving automated equipment, PLC/HMI-controlled systems, sensors, machine controls, and associated mechanical systems.
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing procedures, equipment documentation, batch-record content, and training materials.
  • Provide hands-on manufacturing-floor support during equipment failures, process changes, startup activities, and project implementation.
  • Support project schedules, cost forecasts, and implementation milestones.
Education and Experience Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Biochemical, Biotechnology, or another relevant Engineering discipline strongly preferred. Candidates with a closely related technical degree and substantial directly relevant manufacturing-equipment engineering experience may also be considered.
  • Approximately 5+ years of relevant engineering experience supporting manufacturing equipment and processes.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical-device, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on ownership of manufacturing equipment or processes, including troubleshooting equipment failures and implementing engineering improvements.
  • Ability to provide examples of identifying a manufacturing or equipment problem, determining root cause, implementing a corrective engineering change, and measuring the resulting improvement.
  • Experience improving equipment reliability, downtime, throughput, yield, reject rate, scrap, cycle time, OEE, or comparable manufacturing-performance metrics.
  • Experience with structured root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving.
  • Experience supporting equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, or manufacturing-line implementation.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP requirements, validation, quality systems, document control, and the regulatory impact of equipment and process changes.
  • Experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, engineering protocols, technical reports, risk assessments, or comparable controlled documentation.
  • Strong project-management, organizational, technical-writing, and cross-functional communication skills.
Preferred Equipment Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  • Automated visual inspection or machine-vision systems
  • Vial inspection equipment
  • Filling or fill-finish equipment
  • Vial labeling equipment
  • Pharmaceutical packaging or secondary-packaging lines
  • Cartoners, case packers, conveyors, or automated material-handling equipment

  • Fill-finish manufacturing
  • Pharmaceutical packaging
  • Radiopharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Medical-device manufacturing with strong automated-equipment, validation, and quality-system experience
  • New-product introduction, technology transfer, or manufacturing-line startup
Additional Requirements
  • Must be able to work fully onsite in Noblesville, Indiana, Monday through Friday, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
  • Candidates requiring relocation must be willing to relocate to the Noblesville area at their own expense.

job.title: Facilities Maintenance Technician – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Facilities Maintenance Technician for our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
Pay Rate: $30.00–$32.00 per hour, depending on experience
Location: Maryland Heights, Missouri
Work Arrangement: Fully onsite

This position supports preventive and corrective maintenance of manufacturing equipment, facility systems, and associated support equipment within a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on industrial or facilities maintenance experience, strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills, and experience working with commercial or industrial HVAC systems.

Job Functions
  • Complete assigned preventive maintenance tasks, equipment inspections, and corrective work orders on schedule.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on manufacturing equipment, facility systems, and associated support equipment.
  • Respond to equipment and facility-related breakdowns and complete repairs in a manner that minimizes downtime.
  • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and HVAC-related systems.
  • Support commercial or industrial HVAC equipment and associated controls through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Troubleshoot motors, VFDs, electrical controls, sensors, wiring, PLC/HMI-controlled equipment, and other electromechanical components.
  • Work from electrical schematics, engineering drawings, equipment manuals, and written or verbal instructions.
  • Support pumps, vacuum systems, plumbing, and other facility or manufacturing support systems.
  • Use voltmeters, multimeters, and other test equipment to diagnose equipment failures.
  • Document maintenance and repair activities and verify equipment is safe and operational before returning it to service.
Education and Experience Requirements
  • Associate degree in Electrical Automation, Industrial Maintenance, Electronics, Electrical Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical training.
  • Three or more years of relevant industrial, manufacturing, or facilities maintenance experience.
  • Strong hands-on electrical and mechanical troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience troubleshooting AC/DC electrical systems, motors, controls, sensors, and industrial equipment.
  • Experience reading electrical schematics, technical drawings, or equipment documentation.
  • Experience using voltmeters, multimeters, and other electrical test equipment.
  • Experience with pneumatic and/or hydraulic systems.
  • Ability to work fully onsite during the scheduled hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with commercial or industrial HVAC systems, including preventive maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with equipment such as RTUs, air handlers, chillers, compressors, HVAC controls, or Building Management Systems.
  • EPA 608, HVAC, refrigeration, or related technical certification.
  • Experience with PLC/HMI-controlled or automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Experience with 3-phase or high-voltage industrial electrical systems.
  • Experience with pumps, vacuum systems, plumbing, or facility utilities.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, food and beverage, medical device, chemical, or another regulated manufacturing environment.

job.title: Material Handler - Newburyport, MA
job.description:
NOW HIRING: MATERIAL HANDLERS
Applied Materials | Varian Semiconductor Equipment
Newburyport, Massachusetts

Join the Global Leader in Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology

Applied Materials is the world's leading provider of materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every advanced semiconductor chip and display in the world. Through its Varian Semiconductor Equipment division, Applied Materials is the number one producer of ion implantation equipment worldwide, providing the technology that enables the production of the microchips used in smartphones, computers, artificial intelligence, automotive electronics, medical devices, and countless other technologies.

We are actively seeking Material Handlers to support manufacturing operations at our Newburyport, Massachusetts facility.
Location
Applied Materials / Varian Semiconductor Equipment
4 Stanley Tucker Drive
Newburyport, MA 01950

Additional Coverage Required:
Employees will also provide support as needed at:
428 Newburyport Turnpike
Rowley, MA

Candidates must be comfortable working at both the Newburyport and Rowley locations when business needs require.

Shift
1st Shift
Monday – Friday
7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
$20 to $21.50 per hour 
Opportunity Type
18-Month Contract Opportunities
Excellent Opportunity to Gain Experience with an Industry Leader
Position Summary
The Material Handler is responsible for controlling and maintaining the accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of the stockroom. This role supports manufacturing operations by ensuring inventory accuracy, maintaining stock levels, expediting materials, and coordinating shortages to keep production moving efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
• Receive, store, move, and control materials throughout company facilities.
• Ensure accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of stockrooms.
• Verify inventory levels and maintain stock balances.
• Monitor and communicate material shortages.
• Locate, expedite, and deliver critical materials to support manufacturing operations.
• Load and unload materials, equipment, and supplies.
• Utilize material handling equipment including pallet handlers, skids, and hand trucks.
• Work closely with manufacturing, planning, logistics, and warehouse teams regarding material availability and status.
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.
Qualifications
• Experience loading and unloading materials, supplies, or equipment.
• Warehouse, stockroom, inventory, shipping, receiving, or logistics experience preferred.
• Experience operating pallet jacks, hand trucks, skids, or similar material handling equipment.
• Forklift/Fork Truck experience is a plus.
• Basic computer and inventory tracking skills.
• Ability to follow work instructions and safety procedures.
• Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy.
• Experience communicating material status and coordinating shortages with multiple departments.
 Physical Requirements
• Approximately 80% standing and walking throughout the shift
• Regular lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of materials
• Must be able to lift and move up to 35 pounds
• Ability to work in warehouse and manufacturing environments
Why Work for Applied Materials?
Applied Materials is at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Every day, our technology helps manufacture the chips that power the world's most advanced technologies. Joining Applied Materials means becoming part of a global organization known for innovation, quality, and career growth opportunities. Why Work for Yoh as a contractor?
Benefits of Working with Yoh:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Weekly pay with direct deposit
- Employee discount programs
- Dedicated recruiter support and career guidance
- Opportunities for experience with leading companies and potential conversion
What You’ll Gain:
- Real-world experience in inventory and materials management
- Exposure to ERP systems and supply chain operations
- Skill development in data analysis and process improvement
- A strong foundation for long-term career growth in operations or manufacturing Please apply

job.title: Senior DevSecOps Manager
job.description:
Job Title:  Senior DevSecOps Manager
Type: Full Time
Location: New York City, NY - Hybrid
Salary: $160000- 225000

Our client is looking for a Senior Manager, DevSecOps to lead a group of engineers working across multiple teams integrating security into our DevOps, CI/CD, IaC pipelines, and AI/ML workloads, ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient software delivery across the organization.

As a DevSecOps Sr. Manager , you will oversee technical design and execution across multiple functional areas while providing strategic leadership on DevSecOps best practices, cloud-native security, AI/ML security, and automation. You will lead teams of 2-5+ DevSecOps and security engineers across multiple infrastructure areas, fostering a culture of security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and AI/ML pipelines.
This role requires balancing technical depth in areas such as Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), container security, and AI security with strategic leadership to drive security initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical leader who can architect secure solutions for both traditional and AI workloads, develop their teams' capabilities, and work cross-functionally with engineering teams to embed security practices into every stage of development, deployment, and AI model lifecycle.
They operate at a massive scale, our backend handles over 100B+ events per day, we analyze and process those events in real-time while making decisions on the environment where the ad is running and all the user interactions during the Ad display lifecycle. We verify that all Ads are Fraud Free, Brand Safe, in the right Geo and highly likely to be viewed and engaged, all that in  in under 10ms.

They are global, we have R&D centers in New York, Paris, London, Munich, Belgium, and more. If you like to solve big data challenges and want to help us build a better industry then your place is with us.


Responsibilities will include:
  • Manage and lead multiple DevSecOps teams, mentor and hire senior DevSecOps and security engineers, building high-performing teams focused on security excellence across traditional and AI workloads.
  • Secure AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure by implementing security controls for model deployment environments, ensuring protection against AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model extraction.
  • Establish AI security governance frameworks including policies for LLM usage, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems security, MCP (Model Context Protocol) security, and AI supply chain risk management.
  • Implement automated security scanning for AI artifacts including model files, training datasets, and AI-generated code, integrating these checks into CI/CD pipelines alongside traditional SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.
  • Oversee security for AI workload identity and access management, ensuring proper authentication, authorization, and encryption for AI services, APIs, and vector databases used in RAG systems.
  • Lead AI security incident response for threats specific to AI/ML systems including adversarial attacks, model theft, data leakage through LLM outputs, and unauthorized AI service usage.
  • Ensure adherence to compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX, and MRC by automating compliance evidence collection, with special focus on AI governance and responsible AI principles.
  • Define and execute DevSecOps strategy aligned with business objectives, security requirements, and emerging AI security best practices across the organization.
  • Create architecture designs for security systems and services spanning multiple teams and infrastructure areas, including AI-specific security architectures.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security automation, AI security tooling, and processes across traditional and AI workloads.
  • Establish security metrics and KPIs to measure team effectiveness, security posture, and AI risk exposure.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness and AI security best practices across engineering, data science, and product teams.
  • Collaborate with senior/executive management regularly on security strategy, AI risk management, and cross-organizational security initiatives.
Who you are Experience & Leadership:

  • 5-6+ years of experience in Cybersecurity/DevOps, or DevSecOps, with proven experience leading security teams of ~5+ engineers across multiple infrastructure areas.
  • Leads teams of two or more functional areas with authority over team processes, tools, and priorities; decisions may jeopardize business activities.
  • Regularly interacts with senior/executive management, communicating timeline, scope, and technical concerns to all stakeholders.
  • Leads Sev1/2 incidents for team's areas of responsibility and provides strategic direction during major security events.
  • Exercises supervision over costs, methods, and staffing with responsibility for resource utilization and budget for teams; may have subordinate supervisors or team leads.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience in a related field.
 
DevSecOps Technical Expertise:

  • AI/ML Security: LLM security (prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage), model security, AI supply chain security, adversarial ML defense, RAG system security, vector database security, MCP security.
  • AI Governance & Compliance: Responsible AI frameworks, AI risk assessment, model governance, AI audit trails, privacy-preserving ML techniques.
  • AI Pipeline Security: Securing model training environments, ML pipeline security, model versioning and provenance, AI artifact scanning, AI workload isolation.
  • AI Identity & Access: AI service authentication, API security for AI endpoints, token management for LLM services, workload identity for AI inference.
  • Network Security: Firewalls, segmentation, intrusion detection/prevention systems, AI traffic analysis.
  • Encryption and Cryptography: TLS/SSL, certificate management, encryption at rest and in transit, secure model storage.
  • Identity and Access Management: IAM, Keycloak, Teleport, Workload Identity, AI service accounts.
  • Operating System Security: Hardening, patch management, compliance frameworks.
  • Application Security: Container security, Kubernetes security policies, SAST, DAST, SCA tools, AI-generated code scanning.
  • Threat Intelligence and Analysis: Vulnerability scanning, AI threat detection, adversarial attack detection.
  • Incident Response and Forensics: Security incident handling, AI-specific incident investigation, model forensics.
  • Risk Management and Compliance: SOC2, ISO 27001, SOX, AI governance frameworks, audit preparation and evidence collection.
  • Security Architecture and Design: Zero Trust principles, defense in depth strategies, AI security architecture patterns.
  • Automation and Scripting: Security automation, ACME, certbot, Python, Bash, AI security tooling automation.
  • Cloud Security: GCP, AWS, OCI security controls and best practices, AI service security configurations.
 
Platform & Tooling:

  • AI/ML Platforms: Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML security configurations, LLM API security (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI), vector database security (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB).
  • AI Security Tools: AI red teaming tools, prompt injection detection, model scanning tools, AI observability and monitoring platforms, AI governance platforms.
  • AI Development Tools: LangChain security, LlamaIndex security, AI agent framework security, model registry security, MLflow security.
  • Cloud Platforms: GCP, AWS, OCI with expertise in cloud-native security controls, AI service configurations, and AI workload security.
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins, and Harness with AI security integrations.
  • Container Orchestration: Kubernetes and Docker, with focus on container security and AI workload orchestration.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Terraform, Ansible, or Crossplane for both traditional and AI infrastructure.
 Leadership & Management:

  • Creates architecture designs for systems and services spanning multiple teams and infrastructure areas.
  • Researches new technologies and evaluates for adoption, particularly in AI security domain.
  • Provides blueprints for new services and capabilities across teams.
  • Creates epics and prioritizes work across multiple teams with strong expertise in primary specialization and working knowledge of others.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to balance technical execution with strategic planning, team development, and business objectives.
