job.title: Staff Cloud Network Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Staff Cloud Network Engineer to join our advanced technology client. This role is ideal for a senior-level cloud networking professional who can provide hands-on technical leadership across complex AWS, Azure, hybrid cloud, and enterprise network environments.

The position will focus on designing secure and resilient cloud connectivity, implementing network automation and infrastructure as code, and providing technical direction across cloud and network initiatives. Candidates should be within a commutable distance of the greater San Diego or Los Angeles, CA area and comfortable with occasional travel as needed.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Staff Cloud Network Engineer
Location: Greater San Diego or Los Angeles, CA area
Type: Contract
Compensation: $95.00–$130.00/hour, depending on experience level
Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Person as defined by ITAR due to access to export-controlled technical data and/or technology
 

Responsibilities
  • Lead the architecture, implementation, and ongoing improvement of highly available network environments spanning AWS, Azure, data centers, and enterprise locations.

  • Design scalable cloud connectivity across multiple regions, accounts, and subscriptions using technologies such as AWS Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, Azure Virtual WAN, Virtual Hub, and ExpressRoute.

  • Establish architecture standards for routing, segmentation, DNS, private connectivity, secure internet access, centralized inspection, and hybrid networking.

  • Design and deploy Palo Alto Networks security solutions within public cloud environments, including Cloud NGFW and VM-Series firewalls.

  • Integrate cloud environments with corporate sites, data centers, and other infrastructure using resilient routing, VPN, and private connectivity solutions.

  • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code solutions for network deployment and configuration.

  • Develop network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar technologies to reduce manual processes and improve operational consistency.

  • Implement Git-based development and CI/CD practices for validating, reviewing, testing, and deploying network changes.

  • Partner with Cloud, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and application engineering teams to develop standardized and reusable networking capabilities.

  • Lead advanced troubleshooting of routing, firewall, DNS, connectivity, application access, and network performance issues.

  • Develop monitoring and automated validation capabilities to proactively identify availability, capacity, configuration, performance, and security risks.

  • Lead complex production network changes while adhering to established security and change-management requirements.

  • Maintain network architecture diagrams, engineering standards, runbooks, configuration documentation, and troubleshooting procedures.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other engineers across cloud networking, automation, infrastructure as code, and troubleshooting.

  • Support network technology lifecycle management, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, licensing, configuration improvements, and technical debt reduction.

  • Participate in scheduled maintenance, on-call rotations, vendor escalations, and emergency response as required.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience designing and supporting complex enterprise or production networking environments, with significant experience in cloud networking.

  • Advanced hands-on networking experience across both AWS and Azure, with deep expertise in at least one platform.

  • Experience architecting multi-region, multi-account, and/or multi-subscription cloud networks.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of technologies such as Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Virtual WAN, and site-to-site VPNs.

  • Experience deploying and managing Palo Alto Networks firewalls in AWS and Azure, including Cloud NGFW and/or VM-Series and centralized management through Panorama.

  • Expert-level understanding of BGP, routing, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, redundancy, and network failure scenarios.

  • Strong background in enterprise routing, switching, network security, and hybrid cloud/data-center connectivity.

  • Significant hands-on experience building production infrastructure using Terraform.

  • Experience automating network operations with Python, Ansible, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience with Git, peer-review workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex networking initiatives from architecture and design through implementation and production support.

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and technical leadership skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical discipline or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must qualify as a U.S. Person under applicable ITAR regulations due to the nature of the work and access to export-controlled information.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud-native network security, private endpoints, centralized traffic inspection, DNS architecture, and secure egress patterns.

  • Experience deploying Palo Alto Cloud NGFW or VM-Series within AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government environments.

  • Experience designing high-availability firewall architectures, centralized inspection, load-balancer integrations, and symmetric traffic flows.

  • Experience developing reusable Terraform modules or standardized networking services for consumption by other engineering teams.

job.description:
Materials Planner (Advanced Level-Onsite Role)
Location: Austin, Texas
Shift:  (8-hour) Day Shift 8AM-5PM
Duration: 9-Month Contract
Environment: Manufacturing / Warehouse


Pay Rate: $50 to $56 per hour




What You’ll Do:
  • Planner II supports planning, forecasting, and analysis of service parts and product-related requirements to ensure material availability in the right location, in the right quantities, and at the right time.
  • You will operate within a defined planning scope, applying your foundational planning expertise while executing standard planning processes.
  • This role requires a quick learner with a genuine desire to improve, an eagerness to expand their capabilities, and a strong analytical curiosity and critical thinking.
  • As part of the team, you will deliver reliable planning outcomes while thriving in a product lifecycle-based planning organization that values growth, initiative, and a passion for learning.

 Responsibilities: 
  • Planning Execution: Support demand forecasting, inventory planning, and material planning activities within assigned product or lifecycle scope.
  • Execute planning activities using enterprise planning systems to align supply and demand.
  • Support planning deliverables related to NPI readiness, ECO planning, sustaining operations, and transitions.
  • Develop and maintain production, material, and supply schedules to support customer demand and business objectives.
  • Monitor schedule adherence, identify capacity constraints, material shortages, and supply chain risks, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.
  • Coordinate schedule changes resulting from demand fluctuations, engineering changes (ECOs), NPI builds, and supply interruptions while balancing inventory, service, and operational goals. Ensure planning parameters and scheduling data are accurate to support execution, visibility, and on-time delivery performance.

Problem Solving:
  • Perform part shortage analysis, root cause analysis, and basic scenario evaluation.
  • Identify risks related to material availability, service levels, or transitions and escalate with supporting data.
  • Support corrective implementation under established processes and guidance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Business Units, Service Business Units, Operations, Logistics, and Regional Planning partners to resolve planning issues. Act as a planning point-of-contact within defined scope, communicating status and risks clearly and professionally.

 System Discipline:
  • Maintain accuracy of planning data and support adherence to standard planning processes.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to planning tools, processes, and data quality
  • Build understanding of product lifecycle planning concepts and business drivers.
  • Develop planning judgment by understanding downstream impacts of planning decisions.
  • Progress from executing defined plans to identifying risk and proposing improvements.



What You Bring:
  • Bachelor degree from an accredited university; emphasis in Supply Chain or Engineering, Industrial Engineering preferred.
  • 3-7 years of inventory management, supply planning, or demand planning experience (including KPI management).
  • Semiconductor background strongly preferred, especially in Parts, Warranty, or Service.
  • Proficient with ERP/supply chain systems (Oracle, SAP, SPP, or similar).
  • Self-motivated, accountable, strong project management and innovation skills.
  • Excellent analytical ability; proven use of data-driven analysis to develop solutions. Familiar with Tableau, Power BI, SQL. Skilled in interpreting complex data sets to identify trends and issues.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong collaborator with internal teams and customers.
  • Sound business acumen and understanding of key business drivers.
  • Effective problem-solving, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and structed learning.


Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, or other ERP systems- Background in warehouse, inventory, or manufacturing operations
  • Bachelor's Degree
Years of Experience:
  • 4 - 7 Years

Work Environment:
  • Standing/walking for extended periods
  • Lifting, bending, reaching, and working in tight or fast-paced environments
  • Exposure to noise and manufacturing conditions
  • Required use of PPE (safety shoes, glasses, gloves, etc.)

Benefits of Working with Yoh:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Weekly pay with direct deposit
- Yoh referral bonus programs
- Employee discount programs
- Dedicated recruiter support and career guidance
- Opportunities for experience with leading companies and potential conversion

What You’ll Gain:
- Real-world experience in inventory and materials management
- Exposure to ERP systems and supply chain operations
- Skill development in data analysis and process improvement
- A strong foundation for long-term career growth in operations or manufacturing

job.title: Security Administration Analyst with Sailpoint and ServiceNow- NJ - RTH
job.description:
Security Admin with ServiceNow and Sailpoint
Contract to Hire
Jersey City, NJ

Must Haves:
-ServiceNow, Active Directory, RBAC, Least Privilege Access Principles
-Administer Applications
-SailPoint
-Be able to support IAM/Security Initiatives

Position Overview
The Security Administration Analyst is responsible for executing access management activities, resolving provisioning issues, and ensuring adherence to security policies and least privilege principles. This role requires effective collaboration with global peers, application owners, and security coordinators to deliver accurate and timely access provisioning while maintaining strong control standards.


Key Responsibilities Security Administration & Technical Support
  • Process user access and provisioning requests across multiple systems and applications, in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), ensuring high quality, accuracy and ensuring least privilege principles
  • Participate in onboarding activities (new hires, transfers, and terminations) while understanding the business purpose, risk, and impact of access requests (“the why behind the ask”)
  • Support both standard and more complex access provisioning activities
  • Investigate, resolve access-related incidents and provisioning issues, providing support through ISM support channels (e.g., hotline, service queues)
  • Coordinate with Security Coordinators and Application/Data Owners to validate and fulfill access requests
  • Perform ad hoc operational tasks such as knowledge base updates and documentation maintenance to ensure controls are current, documented, and aligned with best practices
  • Flexibility to support global operations, including periodic shift adjustments, on-call rotational coverage and alternate work schedules to ensure business continuity.
Collaboration & Process Improvement & Execution
  • Collaborate effectively with global teams to ensure consistent security practices and outcomes
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance controls, and improve provisioning processes through automation initiatives using scripting or technical tools where applicable
  • Support continuous improvement by analyzing volume drivers and recurring issues
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across ISM, Technology, and business units
Risk Management
  • Maintain a strong focus on risk management, data protection, and security posture
  • Proactively identify potential risks, support mitigation efforts, escalate issues appropriately and in a timely manner
  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, control awareness, and continuous improvement


Qualifications & Experience Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in Information Security, Identity & Access Management, or related field
  • Experience with security administration tools such as:
    • Active Directory
    • ServiceNow
    • RBAC models
    • Identity & Access Management platforms (e.g., SailPoint or similar)
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel/data analysis skills (Vlookup, pivot tables, VBA etc.)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment
Preferred
  • Experience with scripting/programming (e.g., PowerShell, Python, SQL, Java) for automation
  • Experience in financial services or regulated environments
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes
  • Cybersecurity certifications (e.g., Security+, CISSP)

job.title: Executive Assistant- Long Island City, NY
job.description:
Our finance team is seeking an Executive Assistant (EA) to support the CFO with strategic calendar and schedule management, travel planning, email management, and communication as well as data tracking and reporting and project execution. The EA will maintain a highly organized, proactive scheduling system that keeps the CFO focused on high-value work. Success in this area means a well-structured calendar, clear priorities, and zero avoidable scheduling conflicts. As the EA, you will help ensure the CFO's inbox is organized, prioritized, and managed strategically. You are also responsible for ensuring that internal and external obligations and projects stay on track and you will handle recurring and ad hoc projects as directed by the CFO. The EA ensures that the CFO has visibility on all the deliverables of the Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payroll and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) departments and maintains project trackers and raid logs where necessary. In this key support role in finance, you will also maintain recurring reporting and dashboards, ensuring that leadership has clear visibility into key performance metrics.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
  • Maintaining a structured calendar using block scheduling principles and ensuring meetings are scheduled appropriately with minimal conflicts
  • Reviewing the calendar 24 - 48 hours ahead and proactively adjusting as needed and coordinating travel arrangements and professional events well in advance
  • Reviewing and triaging incoming emails, drafting responses, and delegating communications when appropriate
  • Providing weekly summaries highlighting priorities, deadlines, and emerging issues
  • Tracking assignments and projects delegated by the CFO and maintaining a task dashboard with deadlines and priorities for the CFO and the Finance and Administration direct reports
  • Following up with team members to ensure progress and ensuring projects are completed accurately, on time, in full
  • Handle expense tracking and administrative financial tasks, and support in office management, including coordinating mail, department events and supplies
  • Liaise with Accounting and FP&A in maintaining dashboards and providing hard copies of key reports as requested
  • Prepare PowerPoint and Excel documents for executive, management and board meetings
  • Prepare weekly check-in reports for the CFO
  • Special projects as required
What We're Looking for:
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal Assistant, or Administrative Professional
  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Experience in a multi-entity contractor, construction environment or manufacturing setting preferred
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to anticipate needs and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment
  • Outstanding ability to navigate all aspects of Microsoft Office, including Copilot
  • Experience with scheduling platforms, task scheduling tools, dashboards, and AI agents

job.description:
Position Summary:
Trade Finance Operations Specialist – will be responsible for handling Complex Letter of Credit structuring and manage the LC life cycle for High-priority Trade clients by providing timely and quality support to the clients in facilitating their transactions and processes.  This role may also involve working with various stakeholders like Clients, FIs and NBFIs, simultaneously.

  • Ensure transactions and inquiries of High-priority clients are handled timely and accurately.
  • Applies in-depth knowledge and expertise on service offerings, proactive assessment and resolution of complex transaction issues. 
  • Assist Product and Relationship team with Operational/ transactional insights to manage client expectations.

  • Contribute to workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.

Applicable local / regional licenses or certifications as required by the business.  Trade Certifications (example: CDCS, CSDG etc.) is added advantage.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer *** NO THIRD PARTY CANDIDATES ***
job.description:
*** NO THIRD PARTY CANDIDATES ***
** THIRD PARTY CANIDATES WILL NOT BE UTLIZED **


Senior Software Engineer
Location: offices in Reston, VA; Austin, TX or Menlo Park, CA
** 100% remote will be considered

Employment type: long-term contract, 12+ months


About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build, enhance, and scale the applications, agents, and developer tools that support related platforms and services.
You will work closely with machine learning scientists, software engineers, DevOps professionals, Product, and QA to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, translate evolving product concepts into scalable software, and contribute to technical decisions from architecture through production deployment.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production-quality software supporting AI products.
  • Build and enhance scalable applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with machine learning scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into client products, agents, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Product, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define practical technical solutions.
  • Break down complex or ambiguous requirements into well-defined engineering tasks.
  • Contribute to architecture, technical standards, coding practices, and engineering best practices.
  • Troubleshoot performance, reliability, scalability, and integration issues in production environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, Agile ceremonies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide technical mentorship and support to other engineers.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and documentation.

Required Qualifications
  • At least five years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and developing large-scale, distributed, or cloud-based systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python.
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, preferably using FastAPI.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL or another relational database.
  • Strong understanding of microservices and distributed-systems architecture.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized application development.
  • Experience with automated testing and test-driven development practices.
  • Experience with Kafka or a comparable messaging, streaming, or queueing technology.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Agile/Scrum development practices.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI technologies, including large language models, AI agents, or AI-enabled development tools.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native application deployment.
  • Experience building AI-powered products, agents, platforms, or developer tools.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or comparable tools.
  • Experience working with machine learning engineers, data scientists, or applied AI teams.
  • Experience operating software in security-sensitive, regulated, government, or mission-critical environments.
  • Experience with observability, performance optimization, and production operations.
  • Experience working in an early-stage, high-growth, or highly entrepreneurial technology environment.

What Success Looks Like
Within the first several months, the successful candidate will:
  • Deliver production-ready features across related AI applications and services.
  • Contribute meaningfully to architecture and engineering decisions.
  • Improve system reliability, scalability, testing, and development practices.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and Machine Learning.
  • Help the team use AI-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly.

  • Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
  • Occupational Health/Employee Health/Urgent Care/Emergency Medicine

  • Performs emergency care for occupational and non-occupational injuries and illnesses for employees.
  • Renders on site medical care for non-emergency occupational injuries and illnesses, including assessment, diagnosis, and appropriate treatment
  • Performs assessments and dispositions for employee Surveillance Physicals, taking into consideration the pre-physical test results.
  • Recommends patient specific over the counter and prescription medications and treatments for administration and distribution by nurses.
  • Prepares concise and timely documentation of all patient medical assessment and treatments in the corporate electronic medical recordkeeping system.
  • Provides accurate and consistent OSHA Recordkeeping (OSHA 300 Log & 301’s).
  • Job-site evaluations for ergonomic assessments.
  • Perform Fitness for Duty evaluations.
  • Evaluates, validates, and tracks restrictions.
  • Serves as a resource for ADAPT job placement in the absence of plant physician.
  • Works with the Emergency Response Team.
  • Supports wellness initiatives – Health Education and counseling, disease prevention, health promotion.
  • Assigned medical services will be under the supervision and within the scope of practice of the plant Medical Director.
  • Completes other assignments as requested and assigned.

  • Valid DEA certification.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Physician Assistant in an occupational health environment or related field.
  • Knowledgeable of State and Federal OSHA rules and regulations.

job.title: Analytical QC Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  Analytical Scientist to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time.
The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA
Duration: 3-6 months with ability to extend
Pay: $30-40/hr DOE 
Shift: Wed. - Sat or Sun - Wed.  8am -6pm

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Perform analytical testing utilizing techniques such as AEX, SEC, and purity-based assays.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC and/or UPLC.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ADC/AOC analytical testing or characterization.
  • Experience with SEC, AEX, and purity assays.
  • Experience supporting stability and release testing.
  • Experience with paper-based GMP laboratory documentation/notebooks.
  • Exposure to GC, LC-MS, or capillary electrophoresis (CE).
  • Experience with analytical method development, optimization, qualification, or validation.
  • Experience working within a combined QC and Analytical Development environment.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
What We're Looking For
The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly. Experience with every analytical technique is not required, as training will be provided.
Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.

job.title: Chemistry Lab Assistant
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lab Assistant contractor to help support the bioconjugation team in Bristol, PA.   The Lab Assistant provides support to analysts to ensure testing needs can be completed in a timely manner by maintaining lab supplies, equipment, and materials.

Position:  Lab Assistant 
Location: Bristol, PA 
Duration: 3 months 
Schedule:  M-F 7:30 - 4:30pm 
Pay:  $21-24/hr DOE 

Responsibilities
  • Performs daily checks and calibrations of equipment (e.g. balances, storage chambers).
  • Prepare cleaning solutions for laboratory use. Clean and maintain areas of the laboratory and equipment as needed.
  • Perform routine cleaning following proper procedures for equipment such as biosafety cabinets, incubators, water baths, etc.
  • Daily monitoring and restocking of laboratory supplies and chemicals; ensure proper cycling of supplies (first in first out) and monitor supply expiration dates.
  • Orders and receives samples, lab chemicals, and consumable materials/supplies; maintains inventory of received materials and ensures accuracy of information entered.
  • Prepares buffers and solutions used in the lab; cleans lab glassware and instruments used in reagent preparation.
  • Prepares and labels aliquots of samples and reagents.
  • Records laboratory activities in logbooks and lab notebook by following current good documentation practices (cGDP).
  • Assists with maintenance of laboratory equipment list and perform periodic equipment inventory.
  • Assists with periodic lab-wide cleaning schedule for refrigerators and freezer defrosts; assist with disposal of materials and organization of refrigerator/freezer shelves.
  • Setup and transfer materials for shipping to external clients and across internal sites.
  • Maintains laboratory 5S organization, perform additional duties as needed.

Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, AA/AS or BA/BS in chemistry, biology, or related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with analytical, chemical, or biological laboratory environment.
  • Ability to utilize email, word processing, and spreadsheet software.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

job.title: Enterprise Marketing Specialist
job.description:
Enterprise Marketing Specialist
12 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support the planning, creation, and execution of demand generation campaigns across multiple marketing channels.
  • Develop and deploy email nurture campaigns that support lead generation and advisor engagement goals.
  • Coordinate campaign assets, timelines, approvals, and launch activities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support demand generation initiatives, pilot programs, and marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on schedule.
  • Assist with audience segmentation and campaign targeting efforts.
  • Monitor campaign execution to ensure consistency with brand standards and business objectives.
 
Content Development
  • Create and adapt marketing assets, including: Social media posts, Carousel posts, Infographics, Short-form videos and video reels, Checklists, Guides, E-books, Lead magnets, Landing page content, Email communication
  • Repurpose existing content into multiple formats to maximize reach and engagement
  • Support content customization and personalization initiatives for advisor audiences
  • Assist in maintaining content calendars and campaign schedules
  • Apply best practices for demand generation, lead capture, and audience engagement.
 
Compliance Review & Approval Management
  • Prepare and submit marketing materials for compliance review and approval.
  • Coordinate revisions resulting from compliance feedback.
  • Maintain records and documentation related to marketing approvals.
  • Ensure all materials adhere to brand standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines.
  • Manage timelines and communications throughout the review process to support timely campaign execution.
 
AI Content Enablement
  • Utilize AI tools to improve content development efficiency and campaign execution.
  • Develop, test, and refine prompts for content creation, personalization, and campaign support.
  • Build and maintain a centralized prompt library that can be leveraged across the marketing team.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows through AI-assisted processes.
  • Document repeatable AI-enabled workflows and best practices.
  • Serve as an advocate for responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement within the marketing team.
 
Campaign Measurement & Optimization
  • Tracking campaign performance and engagement metrics.
  • Monitoring lead generation results and conversion trends.
  • Supporting reporting on marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Analyzing performance across email campaigns, lead magnets, content initiatives, and demand generation programs.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance.
  • Providing recommendations based on data and campaign insights.
  • Supporting the development of reporting and dashboards for leadership.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Marketing, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting demand generation, content marketing, digital marketing, campaign management, or marketing operations.
  • Experience developing and executing email marketing campaigns, nurture programs, and lead generation initiatives.
  • Experience creating marketing content across multiple formats, including social media posts, infographics, guides, e-books, checklists, landing pages, and email campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written communication, copywriting, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, WriterAI, or similar tools to support content creation, research, or workflow efficiency.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing data and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and stakeholders.
  • Experience building and optimizing email nurture programs and customer journeys.
  • Experience working with financial services marketing platforms such as AdvisorStream, FMG, Snappy Kraken or similar technologies.
  • Experience utilizing lead tracking processes.
  • Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, or Salesforce reporting.
  • Experience creating campaign performance reports and presenting insights to stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of lead generation, audience segmentation, campaign testing, and conversion optimization best practices.
  • Experience developing prompt libraries, AI workflows, or AI-assisted marketing processes.
  • Experience supporting marketing efforts within regulated industries that require formal approval and compliance review processes.
  • Experience leveraging campaign performance data to recommend business improvements.

Process Technician (GRAVEYARD SHIFT) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Santa Clara, CA.

job.title: Senior AWS Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior AWS Data Engineer
100% Remote (Must reside in lower 48)
Contract (through end of year) with potential conversion (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)


Overview
We’re seeking a Senior AWS Data Engineer to help build and support enterprise, cloud-native data solutions in a large Financial Services environment. This role is primarily focused on AWS engineering, cloud data integration, ETL development, and enterprise data platforms.
Experience with Markit EDM (Cadis) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) is a strong plus, but this is not a traditional “Markit EDM Developer” role. Strong AWS-focused data engineers with enterprise integration experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, develop, and support enterprise AWS data solutions
  • Build scalable ETL pipelines and cloud-native integrations
  • Develop and support REST APIs for enterprise data platforms
  • Create and maintain cloud-based data ingestion and transformation workflows
  • Partner with Architecture, Data Engineering, and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize cloud performance
  • Support initiatives tied to data quality, governance, and enterprise integration
  • Deliver reusable, maintainable solutions using AWS best practices

Required Qualifications (Must Have)
  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience
  • Python
  • SQL
  • ETL development and data integration experience in enterprise environments
  • REST API development/integration experience
  • AWS services such as:
    • AWS Lambda
    • AWS Glue
    • EventBridge
  • Experience building cloud-native applications and supporting production systems

Preferred / Nice to Have
  • Markit EDM (Cadis) exposure
  • Master Data Management (MDM)
  • Security Master / Reference Data platforms or concepts
  • Snowflake
  • Kafka
  • C# / .NET
  • Financial Services background
  • Data governance / enterprise data management concepts

job.title: Thermal Test Technician
job.description:
Thermal Test Technician
We are seeking a hands-on Thermal Test Technician to support thermal testing of semiconductor equipment and hardware. This role focuses on test fixture setup, thermal instrumentation, data collection, and laboratory support.

Scope:
• Set up thermal tests using thermocouples, cold plates, fixtures, and dataloggers.
• Collect and organize test data using spreadsheets.
• Attach, inspect, and adjust thermal test hardware for consistent results.
• Maintain test documentation, equipment, and laboratory work areas.
• Support troubleshooting of thermal test setups and fixtures.

Required:
• Experience with thermal testing, thermocouples, dataloggers, or similar instrumentation.
• Experience collecting and analyzing data in spreadsheets.
• Strong hands-on skills with fixtures, sensors, cold plates, and test hardware.
• Methodical, consistent, and detail-oriented approach to testing.
• Ability to follow technical procedures and document results accurately.

Pluses:
• Experience supporting semiconductor, electronics, vacuum, or advanced hardware testing.
• Familiarity with thermal chambers, LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, or other data-acquisition tools.
• Experience with thermal management, cooling systems, heat sinks, or thermal interface materials.

job.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center PDI Program and Product Portfolio
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Data Center PDI Program & Product Portfolio

Role Overview
The TPM specialist provides comprehensive program support, project controls, and technical product development administration for the PDI Program and Product Portfolio. Operating in lockstep with the Technical Product Manager (TPM) and the Document Control/Knowledge Management (DCKM) teams, this role ensures cross-functional alignment, rigorous change management, and the seamless execution of the Product Life Cycle (PLC).
The ideal candidate must have a technical background and possess a strong Project Management Office (PMO) skillset to effectively support deliverables, follow up on manage complex asset inventories, and maintain engineering documentation.

Core Program Support & Scope
The specialist will provide dedicated PMO and program support for three primary workstreams: Global Regions System Engineering Technical Meetings, Major Program Integration, and System Parameter Input Stakeholder Tracking. Scope descriptions for these programs include:
  • Meetings: Schedule, chair, and document technical meetings. Partner with the TPM to drive scope deliverables, ensuring discussions regarding engineering, design, and pilot testing remain structured, organized, and productive.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Support the Product Development & Insertion Project Management Team, collaborating closely with the Technology Innovation Engineering Team and the broader product development team on design-related discussions.
  • PLC Stage Gate Governance: Assist the manager in driving the Product Life Cycle (PLC) checklist. Support the scheduling, review, and note-taking of stage gate presentations to ensure successful sign-off for each phase.
  • Documentation & Tracker Upkeep: Manage documentation workflows, maintain trackers, and follow up with internal stakeholders to secure reviews and process sign-offs by committed timelines.
  • Engineering Bulletin Coordination: Coordinate Engineering Bulletins (EBs) with relevant parties to verify that technical content is accurate and all supporting documentation is properly linked.

Key Responsibilities
1. Inventory Quantity & Design Update Tracking
  • Device Count Management: Track, audit, and reconcile standard hardware device counts (including automatic transfer switches, network equipment, busducts, and infrastructure components) alongside mechanical drops as data center site layouts migrate from baseline to site-specific configurations.
  • Design Update Auditing: Continuously audit the inventory framework to accurately account for all new hardware releases and specific project configuration modifications.

2. Stakeholder Follow-Up & Data Integration
  • Internal Alignment Execution: Proactively follow up with internal engineering, design, and operations teams to accelerate design reviews, technical drawing releases, and spend approvals (such as data center design engineering approvals).
  • Supply Chain & Vendor Touchpoints: Interface with Equipment Supply Chain contacts and integration vendors to track hardware fabrication timelines, assembly starts, and transit schedules.
  • Major Program Integration: Assist the team in leading coordination efforts across supply chain, internal engineering, and data center services to ensure inventory counts accurately reflect upcoming configurations.

3. Dashboard, Tracker, & Tool Maintenance
  • Program Tracker Ownership: Retain  ownership of the program workflow tracker and roadmap updates (taking direction from lead engineering and portfolio TPM), updating task completions, milestone dates, approved configurations, and assignees weekly.
  • Inventory Dashboard Analytics: Maintain a clean, consolidated dashboard tracking equipment inventory, supplier lead times, allocation maps, and storage locations for spare or excess components.
  • Documentation Repositories: Manage documentation uploads, track stakeholder approvals, and coordinate the drafting/approval of technical bulletins while ensuring accurate technical links are preserved.
  • Status Reporting: Generate structured, periodic reports for leadership focusing on late-binding transition statuses, inventory holding risks, and critical path timeline updates.

4. Lifecycle Documentation Closeout
  • Ensure all project-related information is properly organized, validated for accuracy/quality, and archived within defined closeout periods agreed upon by the TPM and DCKM teams.
  • Incorporate metadata and indexing for optimized searchability, implement access controls, document lessons learned, and manage a seamless handover to operations.
  • Document Management & Collaboration: Proficiency in navigating and organizing data within AODocs, DCIP folder structures, PILs, and DDI platforms to maintain centralized, secure repositories.
  • Issue & Bug Tracking: Direct experience utilizing Buganizer (or equivalent enterprise tracking systems) to log, monitor, and resolve product/program defects.
  • Configuration & Change Control: Solid understanding of engineering change processes, including the administration of Change Control Boards (CCBs), Technical/Product Assessments (TAs/PAs), and Engineering Bulletins (EBs).
  • Data & System Analytics: Ability to manage inventory dashboards, track complex technical assets (ATS, network hardware, busducts), and align data fields across supply chain and engineering roadmaps.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - AUSTIN, TEXAS
job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!

Manufacturing Technician
Applied Materials | Austin, TX | Long-Term 18 Month Contract
First, Second & Weekend Shift Opportunities Available and hourly differentials for second and weekend shift
PAY RANGE: $23.00 - $25.00 PER HOUR

Why This Opportunity?
Applied Materials is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is your opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps build the equipment used to manufacture the world's most advanced semiconductor devices. If you enjoy working with your hands, troubleshooting equipment, and supporting cutting-edge technology, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Why Applied Materials?
• World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
• Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
• Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
• Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and engineering operations.
• Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
• Gain valuable experience working on advanced semiconductor equipment used around the world.
• Opportunity to expand your skills in electrical, mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic systems.

Position Highlights
Location: Austin, Texas

Contract Length: 18 Months

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

First Shift

Second Shift: Additional 10% Shift Differential

Weekend Shift (Friday, Saturday & Sunday): Additional 11% Shift Differential

What You Will Be Doing
• Build, repair, test, and troubleshoot electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies.
• Utilize schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, work instructions, and verbal instructions to complete assemblies and repairs.
• Perform electro-mechanical assembly operations and equipment troubleshooting.
• Identify and correct assembly or testing errors.
• Utilize test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies.
• Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all required materials are available for builds and repairs.
• Inspect parts and completed work for defects and quality compliance.
• Enter production progress, labor, and work order details into computer systems.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and troubleshoot manufacturing processes.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all safety procedures and protocols.
• Properly utilize personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom protocols when required.

What You Need to Bring
• Minimum 2+ years of Manufacturing Technician, Engineering Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, or related experience.
• High School Diploma or Associate Degree.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and mechanical assembly experience.
• Electrical and electronic troubleshooting experience.
• Experience working in manufacturing and assembly environments.
• Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
• Hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical & Environmental Requirements
• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
• Frequent bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching.
• Ability to climb stairs and ladders.
• Comfortable working in tight spaces.
• Ability to lift materials and equipment as required.
• Ability to distinguish between colors.
• Ability to work in industrial environments with varying noise levels.
• Experience using hand tools, power tools, and material handling equipment.
• May operate forklifts and other manufacturing equipment.

This position may require work within a cleanroom environment utilizing:

• Coveralls
• Hoods
• Booties
• Safety Glasses
• Gloves
• Respirators
• Chemical Aprons
• Face Shields

Why Work Through Yoh?
• Weekly Pay
• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
• Life & Disability Insurance
• Weekly Direct Deposit & ePayroll
• Employee Discount Programs
• Access to Yoh opportunities throughout the U.S., UK, and Canada

A Personal Note From Patty Vogel
I have recruited for Applied Materials for many years and have personally watched contractors build outstanding careers with this organization. Many employees have started in technician and manufacturing roles and advanced into leadership and engineering support positions. If you are dependable, mechanically inclined, and looking for a chance to join one of the world's leading technology companies, I would love to speak with you about this opportunity.

Interested?
Contact Patty Vogel, Senior Principal Recruiter, Yoh Staffing

job.title: Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
job.description:
Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
6+ month contract
Downtown Dallas (Hybrid)

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager to lead complex IT integration initiatives within a Microsoft Azure environment. This individual will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects that integrate applications, data, infrastructure, and business processes across the organization.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background managing enterprise IT projects, experience with cloud-based integrations, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, technical resources, vendors, and business stakeholders. This role requires strong leadership, communication, risk management, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end IT integration projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
  • Develop project charters, schedules, budgets, resource plans, communication plans, and risk registers.
  • Coordinate integration efforts across applications, data platforms, infrastructure, security, networking, and business teams.
  • Manage projects involving Microsoft Azure services, cloud migrations, APIs, middleware, data integration, and application connectivity.
  • Partner with solution architects, engineers, developers, business analysts, cybersecurity teams, and vendors to define and deliver project objectives.
  • Establish project governance, milestones, dependencies, reporting standards, and decision-making processes.
  • Monitor project progress, budget, scope, quality, and resource utilization.
  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate project meetings, steering committee updates, status reviews, and executive communications.
  • Manage requirements, change requests, scope adjustments, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Coordinate testing, data validation, deployment planning, cutover activities, and post-implementation support.
  • Ensure projects follow established IT, security, architecture, change management, and compliance standards.
  • Drive issue resolution and escalate concerns appropriately to ensure timely delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and provide regular status reporting to leadership.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience managing complex IT projects, including integration or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects involving multiple applications, systems, or business units.
  • Experience working in Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycles, Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, risks, dependencies, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of application integration, APIs, data flows, cloud services, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Project Management Professional certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or other Agile certification.
  • Experience with Azure integration technologies such as Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Data Factory, or Event Grid.
  • Experience with enterprise application, ERP, CRM, data warehouse, or infrastructure integration projects.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Experience coordinating cloud migration, modernization, or hybrid-cloud initiatives.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, or Smartsheet.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, change management, security, and compliance practices.

job.title: Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Bay Area
job.description:
Materials Program Manager (MPM) - SF Bay Area

Looking for a solid Materials Program Manager to support an autonomous vehicle companies Supply Chain department. This person should have a background in materials planning and understand the key vendors involved in electronics components, mechanical components, automotive components, etc.

 

The key responsibility for this job will be manual demand planning (Manual MRP experience). There is no SAP, ERP, or SW suite that will be utilized, this is all manual production planning/Manual MRP’s through Excel/GSheets, so advanced Excel or GSheet’s experience is a must have.

 

Scope:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. This is the MPM's primary task which will be focused on. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Degree in Supply Chain or similar is ideal.

• Analyze manufacturing build plans against inventory/supply chain data in order to determine demand for materials replenishment.

• Retrieve quotes from suppliers & submit PO’s.

• Manage delivery schedules in order to ensure materials arrive ahead of required dates.

• Track/Mitigate Excess and Obsolescence.

 

Required:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Advanced spreadsheet / Excel skills; Ability to generate complex dashboards, tools, and reports. Experience with excel formulas like - VLOOKUP, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, MIN, etc.

• Solid experience working as a Materials PM, Buyer/Planner, Materials Planners, or similar.

• Understand how to read and understand bill of materials (BOM’s) and manage inventory accuracy.

• Strong knowledge of MRP (Materials Requirements Planning) system functionality.

job.title: Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
job.description:
Senior IT Project Manager

We are looking for a seasoned Senior IT Project Manager to oversee complex technology initiatives involving enterprise integration, cloud transformation, and modernization. This position will manage projects that bring together applications, infrastructure, data, security, and business processes within a Microsoft Azure environment.
The successful candidate will be comfortable operating across both technical and business teams and will serve as the central point of coordination for architects, engineers, developers, security professionals, vendors, and organizational stakeholders. This individual will be responsible for maintaining project direction, managing dependencies and risks, and ensuring initiatives progress from planning through successful implementation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full project lifecycle for complex IT integration and modernization initiatives.
  • Establish project plans, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, milestones, and communication strategies.
  • Coordinate activities across application development, infrastructure, data, networking, cybersecurity, and business functions.
  • Lead initiatives involving Azure, cloud migration, APIs, application connectivity, middleware, and enterprise data integration.
  • Collaborate with technical architects, engineering teams, developers, business analysts, security teams, and external partners.
  • Establish appropriate project governance, decision-making structures, milestones, and reporting processes.
  • Track scope, schedule, budget, resource utilization, quality, and overall project health.
  • Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and potential delivery obstacles.
  • Lead project meetings, working sessions, executive updates, steering committee meetings, and status reviews.
  • Manage requirements, change control, scope adjustments, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project.
  • Coordinate system testing, data validation, deployment preparation, cutover planning, and post-production activities.
  • Ensure project execution aligns with organizational architecture, security, compliance, IT, and change management standards.
  • Facilitate issue resolution and escalate critical risks or decisions when appropriate.
  • Maintain project plans, documentation, status reports, and other governance materials.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience managing complex IT or technology projects.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise integration, modernization, cloud, or systems transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based technology environments.
  • Experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple applications, systems, technical teams, or business functions.
  • Working knowledge of SDLC and project delivery methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.
  • Experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, vendors, risks, dependencies, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, data movement, integrations, and cloud services.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities within a complex, matrixed organization.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PMP or comparable project management certification.
  • Scrum, SAFe, or other Agile certification.
  • Experience with Azure integration technologies such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Data Factory, Event Grid, or Azure Integration Services.
  • Experience managing enterprise integrations involving ERP, CRM, data platforms, infrastructure, or other business-critical applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or automated testing environments.
  • Experience leading cloud migration, application modernization, or hybrid-cloud programs.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or comparable project management platforms.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, security controls, compliance requirements, and organizational change management.
Core Competencies
  • Enterprise technology project delivery
  • Project planning and governance
  • Cloud and systems integration
  • Executive and stakeholder management
  • Risk, issue, and dependency management
  • Vendor and resource coordination
  • Technical communication
  • Strategic planning and execution
  • Change and scope management
  • Problem solving and decision-making
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Leadership through influence
Measures of Success
  • Technology initiatives are delivered within established timelines, budgets, and approved scope.
  • Integration and modernization efforts satisfy business, technical, security, and quality expectations.
  • Project risks, dependencies, issues, and decisions are identified and addressed proactively.
  • Technical and business stakeholders remain aligned throughout project execution.
  • Testing, deployment, and transition activities are completed effectively with limited operational disruption.
  • Project governance, documentation, reporting, and lessons learned are maintained consistently.

job.title: Occupational Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a full-time, 9/80 contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-known client located in Redondo Beach, CA.
 

This onsite clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative health services to support a large corporation. Interesting job getting to be a key part in keeping employees healthy, safe, and able to perform at their best through injury triage, wellness initiatives, and ongoing workplace health support.
-->SHIFTS: 9/80 schedule: Monday-Friday 6:30am to 4:00pm (30 minute lunch)
- One week Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm and Friday 6:30am to 3:00pm and next week, Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of California
  • Previous experience highly preferred: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Strong presentation skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Case management for work-related and non-work related injuries and illnesses, while collaborating with EHS
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Assist with the delivery of the medical surveillance program (audiometric, respiratory, vision, and urine collection)
  • Support company policy in regards to Drug and Alcohol Free Workplace - coordinating drug/alcohol testing (post incident and for cause)
  • Administer immunizations/vaccines
  • Provide counseling, health education, and training programs 
  • Dispense OTC medications
  • Respond to medical emergencies and administer first-aid to employees for job related illnesses and injuries

What You Need to Bring to the Table

  • BLS certified
  • Must be comfortable working autonomously
  • Prior experience using the EMR system, Cority, a big plus!
  • Preferred certifications: CAOHC (hearing conservation), NIOSH (spirometry), COHN (Certified Occupational Health Nurse), and CHES (Certified Health Education Specialist)
  • Proof of US Citizenship (ie valid US Passport or original US Birth Certificate) for security clearance/badging

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Expand your experience alongside a trusted and well-respected organization
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and we place health care professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

 

Recruiter: Hana Daniels
Phone: 818.307.8541

job.title: Senior HR Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior HR Coordinator for our client. In this role, you will provide comprehensive Human Resources support while serving as a resource and mentor to newer HR team members. The Senior HR Coordinator will independently manage more complex HR administrative functions, including leave of absence administration, workers’ compensation, benefits, onboarding, payroll support, compliance reporting, and audit documentation. This position requires strong knowledge of HR regulations, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.

Industry: Human Resources / Life Sciences
Location: Onsite El Monte
Compensation: $60-$62k DOE
Type: Direct Hire


Job Functions
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and handle employee and organizational information with the highest level of discretion.
  • Provide guidance, support, and technical training to Human Resources Coordinators and newer team members.
  • Lead HR projects and initiatives as assigned by Human Resources leadership.
  • Administer the full lifecycle of employee leaves of absence.
  • Administer and coordinate workers’ compensation claims.
  • Respond to employee questions and provide accurate guidance regarding company policies, procedures, and HR practices.
  • Support new-hire onboarding and process employee personnel changes.
  • Assist with timekeeping corrections, attendance tracking, and supporting documentation for payroll processing.
  • Support benefits administration, including open enrollment and processing employee enrollments and changes through applicable benefits portals.
  • Assist with the preparation and administration of employee termination packages.
  • Maintain HR files, records, and reporting documentation required for SOX audits.
  • Provide the Corporate HR Manager with required documentation during internal and external audit processes.
  • Collect and maintain new-hire demographic information, including veteran status, EEO-1 information, and location data, to support compliance reporting.
  • Conduct and support personnel file audits to maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee records.
  • Lead the planning and coordination of HR events and employee-related activities.
  • Ensure HR activities are performed in accordance with applicable labor regulations, HIPAA requirements, wage and hour laws, and company policies.
  • Perform additional duties and HR projects as assigned.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field or a certificate in Human Resource Management required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of Human Resources administration experience required.
  • Strong knowledge of basic labor regulations, HIPAA compliance requirements, and wage and hour laws.
  • Experience administering employee leaves of absence and workers’ compensation claims.
  • Experience supporting benefits administration, onboarding, payroll/timekeeping, and employee record management.
  • Experience supporting HR compliance reporting and audit documentation.
  • Previous experience with HRIS and payroll systems required; Paycom experience is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and related applications.
  • Strong written communication skills with excellent grammar and spelling.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate confidently and clearly with employees and leadership.

job.title: Business Protection Coordinator
job.description:
Business Protection Coordinator (Security Officer)  (Contract)

Location: Miami, Florida (Onsite)
Duration: 12-Month Contract (Subject to Extension)
Pay Rate: $25 hourly W2 

 We are seeking a Business Protection Coordinator to support corporate security operations  This role will be responsible for helping ensure the safety, security, and resilience of employees, offices, events, and business operations throughout the region. The successful candidate will partner closely with regional stakeholders, security vendors, and cross-functional teams to manage physical security programs, incident response, risk assessments, and office security initiatives.
This is a highly visible role that requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to work effectively across multiple countries and cultures. The position is based in Miami, Florida and reports to Business Protection leadership supporting both North and Latin American operations.

Former military, veterans, law enforcement, intelligence, and public safety professionals are strongly encouraged to apply. Experience gained through military service, law enforcement, emergency response, intelligence operations, executive protection, investigations, or related security disciplines is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities Security Operations & Risk Management
  • Support the safety and security of employees, offices, and business operations across Latin America.
  • Monitor and oversee the day-to-day performance of contracted security vendors and guarding teams.
  • Respond to and manage security incidents, investigations, and escalations throughout the region.
  • Conduct risk assessments for offices, events, executive travel, and operations in higher-risk locations.
  • Perform office security audits and recommend improvements to security programs and procedures.
  • Support business travelers and visiting staff with security guidance and risk mitigation measures.
Physical Security & Technology
  • Partner with technical security teams to administer and maintain access control systems, badging programs, alarms, and physical security technologies.
  • Support security planning and implementation for new office openings, renovations, and workplace enhancements.
  • Assist with physical security design reviews and recommend best practices for office environments.
Events & Employee Support
  • Lead or coordinate security operations for corporate events, activations, campaigns, and high-profile gatherings under the direction of Business Protection leadership.
  • Coordinate security planning with vendors, event organizers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver security awareness programs and training initiatives that promote a security-conscious culture.
Collaboration & Strategic Support
  • Serve as a trusted security partner to regional leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to broader security, employee experience, and business resilience initiatives.
  • Provide weekly situational awareness updates and security reporting.
  • Assist with special projects supporting expanding regional operations and office growth initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • Fluent in Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Risk Management, Political Science, International Relations, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in corporate security, physical security operations, intelligence, risk management, crisis management, law enforcement, military service, or related disciplines.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, managing incidents, and implementing risk mitigation strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with access control systems, security technologies, badging programs, and alarm systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern security practices and corporate security operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout Latin America.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Portuguese language proficiency or working comprehension.
  • Experience supporting operations across Latin America.
  • Familiarity with security platforms such as C•CURE (CCURE) or similar access control systems.
  • Experience supporting office construction, security design, or workplace security projects.
  • Knowledge of Apple Mac hardware and Google Workspace tools.
  • Background in military, intelligence, executive protection, emergency management, investigations, or law enforcement environments.

job.title: Technical Vehicle Services (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
job.description:
Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, CAD navigation, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates with experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply.

Scope:
• Write and maintain service manuals, service SOPs, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical reports.
• Convert engineering requirements and test results into clear, repeatable service procedures.
• Document test results, repairs, defects, system configurations, and corrective actions.
• Test, inspect, troubleshoot, and validate electrical and electromechanical vehicle systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, and system documentation.
• Navigate and review existing CAD models, assemblies, drawings, and model trees.
• Locate components, dimensions, notes, features, and design information within CAD files.
• Use basic CAD functions such as view controls, section views, measurements, layers, and assembly navigation.
• Use diagnostic, logging, flashing, and network analysis tools to identify and resolve issues.
• Support root-cause analysis and collaborate with engineering, validation, service, and operations teams.
• Maintain organized lab, shop, vehicle, tool, and inventory areas.

Required:
• Automotive experience required.
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields.
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment, including multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Ability to navigate and interpret existing CAD files; CAD design or modeling experience is not required.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.
• Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or similar platforms.
