job.title: Senior Oracle Data Modeler
job.description:
Senior Oracle Data Modeler 
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas (Hybrid w/ onsite interview)
 
  • Expert proficiency with Erwin Data Modeler (version 9.x or higher preferred) – including subject areas, model templates, and DDL generation.

Primary responsibilities of the Data Modeler include designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade data models that support critical business initiatives, analytics, and operational systems. The ideal candidate is proficient in industry-standard data modeling tools (with hands-on expertise in erwin Data Modeler) and has deep experience with Oracle and SQL Server databases.  The candidate will also translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and normalized data models while ensuring alignment with data governance, performance, and integration standards.
 
Responsibilities
  • Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models using erwin Data Modeler (required).
  • Generate, review, and optimize DDL (Data Definition Language) scripts for database objects (tables, views, indexes, constraints, partitions, etc.).
  • Perform forward and reverse engineering of data models from existing Oracle and SQL Server databases.
  • Collaborate with data architects, DBAs, ETL developers, and business stakeholders to gather and refine requirements.
  • Ensure data models adhere to normalization standards (3NF/BCNF), data integrity, and referential integrity.
  • Support dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas) for data warehousing and analytics use cases.
  • Conduct model reviews, impact analysis, and version control using erwin or comparable tools.
  • Participate in data governance initiatives, including metadata management, naming standards, and lineage documentation.
  • Optimize models for performance, scalability, and maintainability across large-scale environments.
  • Assist in database migrations, schema comparisons, and synchronization between environments (Dev/QA/Prod).
  • Assist in optimizing existing Data Solutions
  • Follow Oncor’s Data Governance Policy and Information Classification and Protection Policy.
  • Participate in design reviews and take guidance from the Data Architecture team members.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of hands-on data modeling experience in enterprise environments.
  • Expert proficiency with Erwin Data Modeler (version 9.x or higher preferred) – including subject areas, model templates, and DDL generation.
  • Advanced SQL skills and deep understanding of Oracle (11g/12c/19c/21c) and Microsoft SQL Server (2016+).
  • Strong command of DDL – creating and modifying tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, synonyms, and materialized views.
  • Solid grasp of database internals: indexing strategies, partitioning, clustering, and query execution plans.
  • Experience with data modeling best practices: normalization, denormalization, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and data vault (a plus).
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and model comparison/diff tools.
  • Excellent communication skills – ability to document models clearly and present to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-Motivated, with an ability to multi-task
  • Capable of presenting to all levels of audiences
  • Works well in a team environment
  • Experience with Hadoop/MongoDB a plus

job.title: Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Techncian-Billerica,MA
job.description:
Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 6-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate: $27 to $32 per hour



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
 

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • As a Manufacturing Technician, you'll work hands-on in a cleanroom environment to build and test our multimillion-dollar display and wafer fabrication equipment 
  • You'll be responsible for building, repairing, and testing various types of equipment--including electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components.
  • You will perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting, and repairs-- and perform audits to ensure necessary parts are available and inspected for defects.
  • Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps you'll test assemblies, complete documentation, perform repairs, or install software to continuously improve our processes
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of processes or procedures through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience.
  • Completes a variety of atypical assignments, as needed. Works within defined processes and procedures or methodologies and may help determine the appropriate approach for new assignments.
  • Completes work with a limited degree of supervision. Likely to act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
  • Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components)
  • Perform a wide variety of electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs
  • Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available; inspect parts for defects; troubleshoot and improve processes
  • Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components
  • Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details; perform computer programming, repair or software installs, as needed
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, and serve as an informal resource for junior colleagues

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • An Associate’s degree
  • 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience
  • Related technical trainings and certifications
  • Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods
  • Demonstrated capability to operate as a peer leader and trainer
  • Demonstrated proficiency for required semiconductor manufacturing concepts and processes
  • ASSEET
  • BSEET (DeVry, TSTC)


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.
  • Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

job.title: Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.

What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

job.title: Cloud Engineer – Data Protection and Cryptography
job.description:
Cloud Engineer – Data Protection and Cryptography,
18 month contract
Plano, TX (Onsite)
 
Seeking a Cloud Engineer to support enterprise data protection, cryptography, and cloud security initiatives. This role will serve as a technical lead and subject-matter expert within a mission-critical environment focused on data encryption, tokenization, and protection policy management.
 
Responsibilities
  • Lead technology projects involving cryptography, distributed microservices, cloud platforms, and full-stack systems.
  • Partner with Cyber product managers, architects, and engineering teams to deliver secure, cloud-based solutions.
  • Assess security risks related to data confidentiality and integrity, identify vulnerabilities, and evaluate potential cyber threats.
  • Design, implement, and support cryptographic solutions, including encryption, hashing, digital signatures, and secure key management.
  • Help mature the enterprise cryptography governance framework, including policies, standards, guidelines, compliance, and auditability.
  • Serve as the technical lead and subject-matter expert for a 5x9 mission-critical data protection environment.
  • Support Protegrity Data Encryption and Tokenization solutions, including data protection policies and platform integrations.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible automation for the lifecycle management of Protegrity Agent software across a large Red Hat Enterprise Linux environment.
  • Use Terraform Enterprise to support AWS serverless deployments and integrations with Protegrity Cloud Protector.
  • Implement and support at-rest encryption using Protegrity Fuse File Encryption technologies.
  • Maintain, enhance, and troubleshoot Protegrity data protection policies.
  • Support integrations with data management platforms, including Snowflake and Teradata.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, participate in technical communities, mentor engineers, and contribute to coding or code reviews as needed.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree.

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.title: Physical Therapist
job.description:
Physical Therapist needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s occupational health client located in McLean, VA. This position primarily focuses on treating orthopedic-related injuries, with a strong emphasis on work-related cases in an outpatient setting. Candidates must have prior outpatient experience and will mostly manage non-surgical musculoskeletal injuries, with minimal exposure to post-operative rehabilitation. The caseload is largely centered on occupational injuries, evaluating, treating, and helping patients safely return to work.
 
Schedule: 7:30a-4:00p
Duration: 11/2-12/18 with possibility of extension (leave of absence coverage)
Pay: $40-65/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Our physical therapist practice according to APTA professional standards, recognizing the importance of current physical therapy research, critical clinical reasoning and the patient’s values when evaluating, assessing and developing a treatment plan for each unique patient
  • We successfully promote direct access to physical therapy services at the majority of our Health Centers, as such our PTs are able to practice at their highest skill level

job.title: Behavioral Health Clinician
job.description:
Behavioral Health Clinician/Psych Nurse needed for a REMOTE contract opportunity with Yoh’s insurance client located in Philadelphia, PA. The Behavioral Health Care Management Coordinator reviews medical and treatment records to assess a member’s behavioral health condition and determine medical necessity for services using established criteria. Collaborates with providers to obtain additional information when needed, independently authorizes medically necessary services, and refers cases that do not meet criteria to the Medical Director for further review. Maintains compliance with regulatory requirements, serves as a patient advocate, and helps members navigate the behavioral health care system.
 
**Candidate must reside in the tri-state area (PA, DE, NJ)
** Candidate must have an active RN, LSW, LCSW, LPC or LMFT to practice in the state of PA

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 730a-4p or 8a-430p
Duration: 10/12-1/07 with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $32-45/hr, DOE

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Applies critical thinking and judgement skills based on advanced medical knowledge to cases utilizing specified resources and guidelines to make case determination. Utilizes resources such as; InterQual, Care Management Policy, Medical Policy and Electronic Desk References to determine the medical appropriateness of the proposed plan.
  • Utilizes the behavioral health criteria of InterQual and/or Medical Policy to establish the need for inpatient, continued stay and length of stay, procedures and ancillary services.
  • Contacts servicing providers regarding treatment plans/plan of care and clarifies medical need for services.
  • Reviews treatment plans/plan of care with provider for requested services/procedures, inpatient admissions or continued stay, clarifying medical information with provider if needed
  • Identifies and refers cases in which the plan of care/services are not meeting established criteria to the Medical Director for further evaluation determination.
  • Performs early identification of members to evaluate discharge planning needs.
  • Collaborates with case management staff or physician to determine alternative setting at times and provide support to facilitate discharge to the most appropriate setting.
  • Reports potential utilization issues or trends to designated manager and recommendations for improvement.
  • Appropriately refers cases to the Quality Management Department and/or Care Management and Coordination Manager when indicated to include delays in care.
  • Appropriately refers cases to Case and Disease Management.
  • Ensures request is covered within the member’s benefit plan.
  • Ensures utilization decisions are compliant with state, federal and accreditation regulations.
  • Meets or exceeds regulatory turnaround time and departmental productivity goals when processing referral/authorization requests.
  • Ensures that all key functions are documented via Care Management and Coordination Policy.
  • Maintains the integrity of the system information by timely, accurate data entry.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • LCSW or LMFT or LPC or Active PA Licensed RN
  • 3+ years of Behavioral Health clinical experience in a hospital or other health care setting. 
  • Prior Behavioral Health utilization management experience is desirable.
  • Medical management/precertification experience preferred.
  • Proficiency utilizing Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, SharePoint, and Adobe programs with the ability to learn new systems as technology advances.

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.description:
Financial Analyst – Technology Portfolio Management Role Summary We are seeking a Financial Analyst to support the Technology Financial Portfolio Management team. This role will provide financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, reconciliation, and operational support across areas such as capital expenditures, operating expenses, invoicing, asset accounting, contractor financials, and technology portfolio planning.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in accounting or financial analysis, be comfortable working with large data sets, and have the ability to communicate financial information clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
Responsibilities
  • Support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and monthly close activities.
  • Prepare accruals, reconciliations, variance analyses, financial reports, and ad hoc analyses.
  • Gather, validate, analyze, and maintain financial and operational data.
  • Assist with annual budgets, monthly forecasts, and long-range planning.
  • Support demand planning and resource planning financial analysis.
  • Track capital projects, construction work in progress (CWIP), project placements in service, capitalization activities, and asset retirements.
  • Support invoice processing, payment tracking, and contractor financial reporting.
  • Maintain financial records and documentation for audits and SOX controls.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to gather information, resolve discrepancies, and explain financial results.
  • Develop insights and recommendations based on financial and operational data.
  • Prepare dashboards, executive reports, and other financial materials for leadership.
  • Ensure work is completed in accordance with established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 2+ years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with large data sets and performing quantitative analysis.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with financial reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Sr. AI Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting contract opportunity for a Senior Engineer, AI Engineering to support a leading advanced technology organization. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys building practical, production-ready AI solutions that improve employee productivity, automate complex workflows, and expand the responsible use of AI across an enterprise environment.

The Senior Engineer will work across AI engineering, business systems, security, data, and other technical teams to develop reusable AI capabilities, integrations, agents, automation workflows, and measurement tools. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience deploying generative AI and large language model solutions in secure enterprise environments.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other technology opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Engineer, AI Engineering
Type: Contract
Compensation: $85-115/hr DOE
Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder (ITAR / CUI environment)

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and support enterprise AI applications, intelligent assistants, agents, workflow automations, prompts, and system integrations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to evaluate manual or inefficient business processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Build AI-enabled capabilities for areas such as knowledge retrieval, document generation, meeting intelligence, internal search, task automation, and employee productivity.
  • Develop reusable AI components, including APIs, connectors, service wrappers, prompt modules, data pipelines, templates, and integration frameworks.
  • Integrate generative AI capabilities with enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, knowledge systems, data environments, and automation tools.
  • Create clear technical documentation, implementation examples, and enablement materials that allow other teams to safely adopt shared AI services.
  • Incorporate security and responsible AI controls related to data access, validation, logging, permissions, and safe model interaction.
  • Support testing, evaluation, version management, deployment, monitoring, and rollback processes for AI models, prompts, agents, and related services.
  • Develop dashboards and telemetry to track AI adoption, reliability, usage, operating cost, performance, and policy compliance.
  • Analyze usage and system performance to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, lower costs, and stronger user adoption.
  • Help quantify the business impact of AI solutions through metrics such as time savings, throughput improvements, reduced errors, and productivity gains.
  • Collaborate across Engineering, IT, Security, Legal, Data, Finance, and business functions to deliver secure and maintainable solutions.
  • Share reusable patterns, technical lessons, demonstrations, and best practices with broader AI and engineering communities.
Qualifications
  • Progressive experience developing enterprise software, automation, data solutions, AI applications, or digital workplace technologies.
  • Hands-on experience implementing generative AI or large language model capabilities within production or enterprise environments.
  • Experience with technologies such as LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, prompt orchestration, intelligent automation, or similar AI frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API development, testing, observability, documentation, secure coding, and maintainable application design.
  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, collaboration tools, knowledge repositories, data platforms, or workflow automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI security and governance concepts, including access controls, data classification, auditability, prompt safety, output validation, and version management.
  • Experience developing telemetry, logging, dashboards, usage analytics, or cost/performance monitoring for production systems.
  • Ability to translate loosely defined business challenges into practical technical requirements and working solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across both technical and non-technical teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting technology in regulated, security-sensitive, aerospace, defense, or highly governed environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, copilots, vector databases, enterprise search technologies, and workflow automation ecosystems.
  • Experience with MLOps, AI observability, model evaluation, prompt testing, agent testing, or production AI monitoring.
  • Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, lakehouse environments, or comparable technologies.
  • Background developing technology usage dashboards, cost reporting, chargeback/showback models, or ROI measurement.
  • Experience contributing to shared engineering libraries, internal developer platforms, reusable templates, or technical enablement programs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Financial Analyst
job.description:
Financial Analyst – Technology Portfolio Management Role Summary We are seeking a Financial Analyst to support the Technology Financial Portfolio Management team. This role will provide financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, reconciliation, and operational support across areas such as capital expenditures, operating expenses, invoicing, asset accounting, contractor financials, and technology portfolio planning.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in accounting or financial analysis, be comfortable working with large data sets, and have the ability to communicate financial information clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
Responsibilities
  • Support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and monthly close activities.
  • Prepare accruals, reconciliations, variance analyses, financial reports, and ad hoc analyses.
  • Gather, validate, analyze, and maintain financial and operational data.
  • Assist with annual budgets, monthly forecasts, and long-range planning.
  • Support demand planning and resource planning financial analysis.
  • Track capital projects, construction work in progress (CWIP), project placements in service, capitalization activities, and asset retirements.
  • Support invoice processing, payment tracking, and contractor financial reporting.
  • Maintain financial records and documentation for audits and SOX controls.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to gather information, resolve discrepancies, and explain financial results.
  • Develop insights and recommendations based on financial and operational data.
  • Prepare dashboards, executive reports, and other financial materials for leadership.
  • Ensure work is completed in accordance with established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 2+ years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with large data sets and performing quantitative analysis.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with financial reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate financial data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
Preferred Experience
  • Financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Understanding of accounting principles, capitalization, depreciation, and asset management.
  • Experience supporting technology projects, applications, or technology operations.
  • Experience with financial, reporting, portfolio management, or asset management tools.
  • Exposure to CapEx, OpEx, CWIP, invoicing, contractor financials, or technology portfolio management.

job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner needed for a full-time hybrid, contract-to-hire opportunity supporting Yoh’s well-known corporate office client based in Downtown Los Angeles, CA. 
  • Work 9:00am to 5:00pm onsite 3 days/week in Downtown LA (including alternating Wednesdays & Fridays); telemedicine on non-clinic days
  • Travel required to Century City when needed, in addition to San Diego, Orange County, and San Francisco (frequency TBD - likely monthly for SoCal and quarterly for NorCal).

This is a newly created position joining an established onsite medical clinic team that already includes a Nurse Practitioner, Physical Therapists, and Mental Health Counselors. You'll serve as the highest level of medical care for a high-performing workforce of 700+ employees. Must be comfortable working autonomously as you will likely be solo onsite, alternating with the other NP.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active Nurse Practitioner (FNP/ANP) license in state of California
  • Current prescription authority
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a provider
  • Previous experience in Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, or Family Practice
  • Comfortable performing blood draws
  • Prior experience with telehealth

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Injury/illness triage and treatment
  • Immunizations and travel vaccines
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty)
  • Ambulatory care (sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.)
  • Onsite testing for strep, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia/hypoglycemia
  • Dispense OTC medications (back pain, headache, pharyngitis)
  • Phlebotomy

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • National Certification (ANCC or AANP)
  • Current BLS/CPR (AHA or Red Cross)
  • NPI
  • Annual TB Test or QuantiFERON Gold
  • Strong computer skills; EMR experience required; Quest experience a major plus
  • Interpersonal skills to interview, teach, counsel, and interact with employees and clients

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your experience with a trusted, well-respected organization
  • Work in a unique, rewarding environment where you make a real impact on individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

job.description:
Senior Research Associate - Onsite, Cambridge, MA

We are seeking a Senior Research Associate to support transcriptomics studies across a range of sequencing platforms, including bulk RNA sequencing, small RNA sequencing, long-read sequencing, single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and related technologies.

Responsibilities include:

  • Perform RNA sample preparation activities, including RNA isolation, library preparation, quality control, and sequencing.
  • Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot next-generation sequencing equipment.
  • Manage sample tracking, storage, and logistics throughout the data generation process.
  • Prepare detailed protocols, technical documentation, and data reports.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and contribute to the development, optimization, and implementation of new and existing workflows.
  • Support multiple projects and adapt to changing platform, workflow, and study requirements.
  • Train and assist team members as needed.
  • Maintain accurate records of laboratory activities, equipment performance, and study results.
  • Follow applicable laboratory procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on, detail-oriented scientist with experience in RNA sequencing workflows, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative research environment.

job.title: Quality Control Manager – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Control Manager for our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position will lead Quality Control laboratory operations during the Saturday–Wednesday shift. We are seeking an experienced pharmaceutical QC laboratory leader with a strong analytical chemistry background and hands-on knowledge of analytical testing and laboratory instrumentation.

This is not primarily a Quality Assurance or quality systems position. The successful candidate should have the technical depth to lead analytical QC personnel, review and interpret laboratory data, support investigations, and provide technical guidance when testing or instrumentation issues arise.

Location: Noblesville, IN – Fully Onsite
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Salary: $115,000–$135,000 base
Schedule: Saturday–Wednesday, 4:00 AM–12:30 PM

Essential Job Functions
  • Lead and develop a team of Quality Control laboratory personnel supporting pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Coordinate laboratory testing schedules, resources, and instrumentation in support of production activities.
  • Oversee testing of raw materials, components, intermediates, finished products, stability samples, validation samples, and protocol/experimental samples.
  • Provide technical leadership for analytical chemistry testing and major laboratory instrumentation.
  • Review and interpret laboratory data and make appropriate cGMP and compliance decisions.
  • Perform or support laboratory testing as needed.
  • Support and review investigations involving laboratory results, process or product failures, deviations, exceptions, and customer complaints.
  • Ensure timely completion of corrective actions and other quality-related commitments.
  • Review and maintain controlled laboratory documentation, procedures, and records.
  • Ensure team compliance with applicable cGMP requirements, company procedures, and regulatory expectations.
  • Maintain employee training and qualification requirements.
  • Measure and communicate team performance against department goals and KPIs.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop employees while managing individual and team performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, and other site functions.
  • Maintain a safe and compliant laboratory environment, including adherence to applicable radiation safety and ALARA requirements.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Science, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 7+ years of relevant pharmaceutical Quality Control or laboratory experience.
  • Previous supervisory or people-management experience required.
  • Strong experience working within a cGMP pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratory.
  • Demonstrated experience with analytical chemistry testing and major laboratory instrumentation.
  • Prior hands-on analytical testing experience with the technical depth to support and troubleshoot laboratory activities.
  • Ability to interpret analytical laboratory data and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Experience with laboratory investigations, deviations, CAPA, and other quality events.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical raw material, in-process, finished-product, and/or stability testing.
  • Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work onsite Saturday–Wednesday, 4:00 AM–12:30 PM.
  • This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.
Candidates who are not currently local to Noblesville but are open to relocation may be considered.


#IND-SPG

Marketing coordinator will work in the marketing department providing an excellent experience through stellar logistic and data management. This coordinator must be organized, detail-oriented, and data savvy, as well as have flexibility and the ability to prioritize new tasks as they come in. Position requires the utmost care in client relationship and discretion. This position is located in Sony Music’s Culver City office. Compensation up to $25/hourly.

Marketing Coordinator will work with the Marketing Team providing support in different areas. This Marketing Coordinator must be punctual, organized, detail oriented, able to multitask and be flexible to assist in several roles while prioritizing the team’s needs.

Position requires the outmost care and confidentiality.

What you’ll do:

  • Own general administrative duties

job.title: Lead Assembler, Cleanroom III (2nd Shift)
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Lead Assembler, Cleanroom III – Second Shift for our medical device manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for the routine assembly and packaging of medical devices while providing day-to-day leadership and training to team members within an assigned work center. The Lead Assembler will oversee assembly line setup and flow, operate packaging equipment, complete required documentation and ERP transactions, and ensure all work is performed according to established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality requirements, and safety standards.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Santa Fe Springs, CA 

Job Functions
  • Lead daily assembly line activities and oversee team members working on assigned production lines.
  • Set up production lines and maintain proper workflow throughout the shift.
  • Perform hands-on assembly and packaging of medical devices and related components.
  • Independently package and assemble parts and components, perform sealing operations, and operate production equipment with limited or no supervision.
  • Train and provide guidance to other Assemblers within the assigned work center.
  • Ensure cleanroom and production area cleanliness standards are consistently maintained.
  • Perform routine cleaning of packaging equipment and manufacturing areas.
  • Periodically clean, assemble, and disassemble packaging machinery.
  • Ensure Good Documentation Practices (GDP) requirements are followed and production documentation is completed accurately.
  • Complete required transactions within the ERP system.
  • Read, understand, and follow Manufacturing Outlines (MOs), Engineering Work Orders, and Rework Orders.
  • Follow written instructions for production startup, assembly activities, batch completion, work orders, in-process testing, batch records, and applicable SOPs.
  • Follow SOPs and manuals related to safety, material safety information, packaging, cleaning, and the assembly/disassembly of machinery.
  • Perform basic mathematical calculations required to support completion of packaging batches.
  • Meet established project deadlines and performance standards.
  • Maintain compliance with all company policies, procedures, safety requirements, and regulations.
  • Understand and adhere to the company's Quality Policy.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Previous experience performing assembly and/or packaging activities in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working with medical devices and/or within a cleanroom manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead an assembly line and provide training to other team members.
  • Must be proficient with computers and comfortable completing transactions within an ERP system.
  • Must be able to thoroughly read and understand Manufacturing Outlines (MOs).
  • Ability to understand and follow Engineering Work Orders, Rework Orders, batch records, written work instructions, and Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Ability to work independently and perform assembly, packaging, sealing, and equipment operation with limited or no supervision.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate production documentation.
  • Ability to meet production deadlines and established performance standards.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Second-shift, onsite cleanroom and manufacturing environment.
  • Regularly required to stand, sit, walk, and use hands to assemble, package, and handle medical device components.
  • Ability to perform repetitive assembly and packaging activities throughout the assigned shift.
  • Ability to operate, clean, assemble, and disassemble packaging equipment and machinery.
  • Must be able to follow applicable cleanroom gowning, cleanliness, safety, and manufacturing procedures.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Gen AI Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Location: Boston ONLY
Hybrid: 3 Days
Convert: Yes (USC/GC ONLY)
Interview 3-4 Rounds Possible in person
Start Date: ASAP
Bill Rate: $120-135

 Must Haves:
Leadership Skills
Reports status to leadership weekly
Strong understanding of Gen AI, cloud platforms, security, and legal.
Very strong, no hand holding
Strong communication and presentation skills
Financial services experience a plus

 

 

 

AI Technical Project Manager

AI Technical Project Manager to lead the adoption of AI-enabled products, platforms, and solutions across the organization. This role combines strong project management discipline with technical understanding of AI/ML technologies, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering practices. The individual will coordinate cross-functional teams across Software Development, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Risk Management and Vendor Management, manage delivery risks, align stakeholders, and ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable business value while meeting security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Main areas of responsibilities:

AI Program and Project Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Generative AI, Agentic AI and Machine Learning initiatives.
  • Define project scope, objectives, success metrics, milestones, and delivery plans.
  • Establish and manage project schedules, budgets, resources, and dependencies.
  • Drive execution across multiple concurrent AI projects and workstreams including developer productivity and legacy code modernization platforms.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address risks, blockers, and issues.
  • Build strong partnerships across Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Business teams.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, and competing demands.
  • Act as the primary liaison between technology teams, control functions, legal and vendors.
  • Deliver clear and concise status updates to senior management and executive stakeholders
AI Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish approved usage patterns, governance standards, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure AI projects comply with internal governance frameworks and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate risk assessments, legal reviews, cybersecurity evaluations, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams on integrations, security controls, and platform enhancements.
Technical Leadership & Coordination

  • Facilitate technical design discussions and challenge assumptions to optimize solutions.
  • Ensure alignment between AI solutions, enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity requirements and infrastructure strategy.
  • Partner with AI Development, Cyber Security, Vendor Management and Infrastructure teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
Value Realization & Reporting

  • Define KPIs and success metrics for AI platforms.
  • Track utilization, productivity gains, cost optimization, and return on investment.
  • Build executive dashboards and adoption reporting.
  • Recommend expansion, optimization, or retirement of AI capabilities based on business value and usage data.
Qualifications:

Required

  • 10+ years of Project Management, Program Management, or related experience.
  • 3+ years leading Gen AI and Machine Learning initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI SDLC, cloud platforms, developer productivity tools, and enterprise architecture concepts.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Cyber, Risk, Compliance, and Legal.
  • Strong analytical, communication and executive presentation skills.
Preferred

  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Azure Foundry, Claude Code or similar enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience leading enterprise technology adoption and/or change management initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, software development practices, cloud platforms.
Preferred Certifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent.
  • Generative AI Certification from Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks, or equivalent, covering LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, enterprise AI architecture, security, and responsible AI.

job.title: Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Reliability Engineer for our Research and Development client in Marietta, Ohio.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive reliability plans aligned with product requirements, program milestones, and regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with R&D engineers and test technicians to define test strategies, protocols, and acceptance criteria for cold storage products.
  • Support verification and validation testing by ensuring appropriate reliability coverage, stress conditions, and data collection.
  • Create and maintain standardized reliability methods, test procedures, and design guidance to enable repeatable, high-quality evaluations.
  • Lead and facilitate Design FMEA (DFMEA) activities and contribute to broader product risk management efforts.
Education Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • Advanced coursework in Reliability Engineering or professional reliability certification preferred
Experience Requirements:
  • 5+ years of experience performing reliability engineering, product approval, or verification testing for complex electromechanical systems
  • 3+ years of experience supporting design and development of mechanical or electromechanical products
  • Experience with HVAC/R, refrigeration, or thermal systems strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting regulated product testing (e.g., UL, IEC, NSF, Energy Star, DIN, or similar standards)
  • Hands-on experience with test method development, accelerated life testing, and failure analysis
  • Experience with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical reporting
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems
  • Strong understanding of system-level reliability principles and product testing methodologies

job.title: Occupational Health RN
job.description:
Yoh Healthcare has a direct hire opportunity for an Occupational Health Registered Nurse in Columbia City, IN

About the Role

The Occupational Health Nurse reports directly to the General Managers at their respective location and indirectly to the Occupational Health Coordinator. The successful candidate holds a valid nursing license in the state of Indiana and current certification in CPR/AED from American Red Cross or AHA.

Hours: 7am- 4pm Monday-Friday

Key Responsibilities
  • Treatment of on-site injuries and referral to outside medical care as needed
  • Case management for injured workers and facilitate return to work
  • Provide medical surveillance for all employees including but not limited to annual audiograms, spirometry, vision screening, and lead testing
  • Provide medical surveillance and case management
  • Conduct new hire pre-employment drug and alcohol screening & coordinate medical examinations
  • Participate in ergonomics assessments and job hazard analysis
  • Responsible for training employees in First Aid and CPR/AED as medical responders to aid in the care of injured workers
  • Responsible for training employees in Bloodborne Pathogens, Hearing Conservation, Violence in the workplace, Ergonomics and Heat Stress to meet OSHA requirements
  • Maintain HIPPA compliant documentation
  • Accountable for delivery of agreed to regional health metrics and outcomes
  • Purchase all supplies required for the first aid clinic
  • Develop and meet site budget expectations
  • Drive increased health outcomes including reducing population health risks, managing, and eliminating workplace health risks and supporting improved business outcomes through advancing employee health and wellbeing
  • Willingness to work closely with the Safety Coordinators at the division level to recognize hazards and prevent injury
Required Qualifications
  • Active RN license in Indiana
  • On-call being requierd for after hours for injuring management. On-call is split between team
  • 2 or more years hospital or clinic nursing experience in occupational (manufacturing/industrial)  nursing or emergency nursing
  • Excellent assessment skills in a clinical setting
  • Phlebotomy
  • Current CPR/AED certification
Preferred Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of regulatory areas (ADA, OSHA, FMLA, Workers’ Compensation)
  • CPR/AED Instructor
  • Health coaching/certification
  • Certified Occupational Health Nurse
 
What’s In It for You?

  • Bonus opportunities 
  • Stock Benefits
  • Profit Sharing and Retirement Savings
  • Medical, Educational, & Life Insurance coverage
What are you waiting for? APPLY NOW!

job.title: Oracle Golden Gate DBA
job.description:
Oracle Golden Gate DBA
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas (Hybrid)
 
Essential Skills and Competencies:
  • Minimum 8+ Yrs. relevant experience in Oracle Database Administration
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle 19c installation and administration
  • Strong experience with Oracle Golden Gate (Classic and Microservices architectures)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Golden Gate installation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production environments
  • Experience with Oracle database environments including RAC, ASM, Data Guard, Exadata, and OEM to ensure high availability and consistency of replicated data
  • Strong experience with Oracle Data Pump (Export/Import) utilities
  • Proficiency in database performance tuning (AWR, ADDM) and exposure to OEM monitoring
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and documentation skills
  • Willing to work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts
  • Knowledge of shell scripting and automation frameworks
  • Candidate should be able to quickly understand and resolve issues, mitigate risks and dependencies and the ability to drive assignments to completion 
 
Responsibilities:
  • Install, configure, and administer Oracle Golden Gate (Classic and Microservices architecture) for real-time data replication
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Golden Gate processes to resolve issues such as replication lag, data conflicts, and process failures
  • Instantiate new tables and backfill table modifications in a replicated environment
  • Develop and maintain shell scripts for reporting, automation, and Golden Gate monitoring
  • Contribute to performance optimization, troubleshooting, and capacity planning of high-volume replication systems
  • Utilize AWR, ADDM, and other performance tools to analyze and improve database and replication performance
  • Implement performance tuning to enhance throughput and replication efficiency
  • Implement, configure, and maintain Data Guard and RAC environments, handling day-to-day administration and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate with application teams on new data replication requirements and modifications to existing data replication processes
  • Attend DBA team meetings and follow Oncor standard DBA practices
  • Prior experience of working in a DevOps / Agile environment  
  • Working knowledge of JIRA is a plus
  • Experience working in heterogeneous database replication environments is a plus
  • Cloud experience is a plus

job.description:
Pay range: 26-28/hr 


Key Responsibilities:
**Short Term 30 day contract** 
Onsite in Sunnyvale 5 days a week  
Technical Support
•Provide first-level technical support for end users via phone, email, Atlassian Service Desk/Jira, Slack, and in-person
•Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Mac and PC laptops, desktops, peripherals, and mobile devices
•Diagnose and solve software problems across various applications including Microsoft Office 365 suite
•Support remote workers by configuring and troubleshooting VPN connections
•Maintain and troubleshoot network connectivity issues including Cisco Meraki network devices
•Review service dashboards as first level triage and handle appropriate escalation of issues
•Lead and manage the comprehensive IT onboarding process for all new employees
•Prepare and configure hardware (laptops, phones, peripherals) for new employees
•Create and set up necessary accounts across all systems and platforms
•Conduct IT orientation sessions for new employees
•Maintain detailed inventory of IT assets assigned to employees
Collect and securely store SSH keys for appropriate staff members
• Configure and maintain VPN access for remote workers
• Administer user accounts in Active Directory and Microsoft 365 environment
• Manage user access to Atlassian products, GitHub repositories, and Dropbox shared folders
• Manage Microsoft 365 tenant including user creation, licensing, and permissions
• Configure and troubleshoot email accounts, distribution lists, and shared mailboxes
• Provide support for Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and other Microsoft 365 applications
• Assist with Microsoft 365 security configurations and compliance requirements
Conference Room Management
• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot video conferencing equipment
• Ensure conference rooms are properly updated and functioning for meetings
• Provide user training on conference room technology
•Create and maintain documentation for IT processes, procedures, and troubleshooting guides
• Track all support requests through Atlassian Service Desk/Jira ticketing system

Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• 3+ years of experience in an IT support or helpdesk role
• Demonstrated experience supporting both Mac and Windows environments
Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems
• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint)
• Familiarity with network protocols and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
• Understanding of VPN setup and maintenance
• Experience with SSH key management and secure access protocols
• Knowledge of Active Directory and user account management
• Experience with Cisco Meraki network equipment configuration and troubleshooting
• Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Service Desk, Confluence)
• Experience with GitHub repository management and user access
• Familiarity with Dropbox administration and sharing permissions
• Experience using Slack for team communication and support
• Ability to monitor and interpret service dashboards for system health

Preferred Skills
•Familiarity with scripting and automation tools:
o PowerShell for Windows automation
o Python for scripting and automation
o Terraform for infrastructure as code
o Ansible for configuration management

•Experience with monitoring tools and service dashboards
•Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP)
•Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
Soft Skills
•Excellent customer service attitude with strong interpersonal skills
•Clear communication abilities with both technical and non-technical users
•Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
•Ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment
•Self-motivated with the ability to work independently when needed
Certifications (Preferred)
•CompTIA A+ Certification
•Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate
•Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP)
•ITIL Foundation Certification
•Cisco Meraki Network Associate Certification
•Atlassian Certified in Jira Service Management

job.title: Maintenance Manager - Chemical Manufacturing
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Maintenance Manager-Chemical Manufacturing in Temple, TX. This role will be a responsible for execution of capital projects and developing and implementing preventive/predictive maintenance programs, coordinating corrective maintenance ensuring equipment reliability, managing and mentoring a team of maintenance and construction professionals, and supporting operational excellence in a regulated, safety-first environment.
 
Title: Maintenance Manager
Duration: Direct Hire 
Pay: $120,000/yr
Location: Temple, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Responsibilities:
  • Maintenance and construction activities management: Develop, Plan, organize, lead and manage corrective/preventive/predictive maintenance programs and activities to ensure reliability and cost efficiency of the plant overall operations, within budget, and to standard
  • Lead Execution of capital projects and plant upgrades: Coordinate installation and commissioning following headquarters Engineering team plans, instructions, design and costs approved
  • Equipment working conditions: Collaborate with Operations teams to improve equipment uptime and reliability and ensure machinery and equipment are maintained in optimal working conditions
  • Supervise and coordinate daily activities of maintenance and technical staff
  • Plant Turnarounds and Emergency Repairs: Provide leadership in emergency repairs and plant shutdown/startup activities
  • CMMS: Ensure all maintenance work is documented and tracked via Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Cost Control: Monitor and manage Maintenance budgets, labor and contractor costs, spare parts inventory to grant budget goals
  • Performance and Reporting: Develop, implement and report maintenance performance reports, KPIs, and improvement initiatives, to senior management and organization. Reports, KPI’s and initiatives have to drive continuous improvement and positive change aligned with company strategical goals
  • Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance: Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other applicable safety and environmental regulations and policies, including chemical handling, waste disposal, and emergency procedures. Collaborate with Company organization to continuously improve safety
  • People management and development: Manage, train and mentor construction and maintenance staff, including contractors, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and industry standards. Foster a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement. Be the positive change agent. Comply with company people management processes (performance reviews, trainings etc.
  • Continuous improvement Culture: Analyze maintenance data to identify bad actors, and flaws, propose and implement improvements to maximize reliability, reduce downtime, minimize waste and costs
  • Cross functional initiatives: Lead or participate company x-functional initiatives.
Required:
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering – or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of maintenance experience in a chemical, petrochemical, or relevant industrial manufacturing environment
  • Minimum 2 years in a progressing management role.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, electrical controls, pumps, compressors, and process equipment
  • Experience with CMMS platforms (Limble, SAP PM, Maximo, or similar
  • Fluent in English (read, write, and comprehend) is required
  • An active, valid driver’s license and a good driving record for past 5 years

#IND-SPG

job.title: Implementation Specialist
job.description:
🚀 Love technology, training, and helping teams embrace change? We're partnering with a well-established industry leader to find an Implementation Specialist who thrives on organization, communication, and making complex projects run seamlessly. This 6-month contract-to-hire opportunity offers the chance to play a critical role in software rollouts, system implementations, new location openings, and acquisition integrations across a growing organization.

If you're someone who enjoys coordinating moving parts, working directly with end users, creating engaging training experiences, and ensuring successful technology adoption, this could be the perfect next step in your career. You'll work closely with IT development, training, and support teams to deliver impactful solutions that help drive business success across the organization.

✈️ This is not a desk-only role. You'll have the opportunity to travel extensively throughout the United States, partnering with teams on-site during critical implementation events, training initiatives, new facility openings, and system rollouts. For professionals who enjoy building relationships, experiencing different locations, and seeing projects through from planning to execution, this role offers a unique blend of technology, training, and travel.

Ready to be at the center of exciting technology initiatives while building a long-term career opportunity? We'd love to hear from you.  Please submit application here or send resume to Melissa Werner @ melissa.werner@yoh.com

Reports to: Implementation Project Manager Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelors’ degree with major work in business administration, education, computer sciences, or a similar business-related field.
  • At least three years full-time employment working in a related area.
  • Must be able to analyze business process and procedures, and software applications to identify key training points and develop training programs to support them.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Work, PowerPoint, Outlook); advanced experience with MS Excel is required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and listening skills.
  • Must be able to demonstrate experience in persuading and motivating others. Exercises tact, sound judgment and self-discipline.
  • Excellent organizational and administrative skills.
  • Experience in developing training materials and presenting training to small groups.
  • Ability to travel for extended periods of time and on short notice.
  • Ability to pick up 45 pounds.
  • Ability to travel via aircraft.
  • On occasion, must be able to travel and work on weekends.
 Preferred Qualifications:
  • Work experience includes complex scheduling responsibilities. Must have experience applying project management methods and techniques to developing schedules.
  • Has knowledge of commonly-used training concepts, practices, and procedures.
  • Proficient using MS Project application.
 Working Conditions:
  • This position operates in a professional office environment, which may require sitting for extended periods.
  • Occasional travel to U.S. warehouse facilities
Supervisory responsibilities: No Essential Job Functions:
  • Manage the implementation process for multiple assigned projects. Projects may include software or procedural rollouts; new location openings, closures or mergers; and new company acquisitions.
  • Act as the primary interface between the IT Department and the various field organizations for assigned projects.
  • Coordinate IT and other CED Service Center resources to achieve project objectives.
  • Identify and analyze implementation or training project requirements to define project scope, requirements and deliverables. 
  • Provide training and end-user support during and after the implementation process.
  • Designs, develops and presents instructor-led training in-person or via Webinars
  • Share and communicate best practices to CED Service Center groups and field resources.
  • Assist the Help Desk to develop and maintain Knowledgebase articles.
  • Organize multiple work tasks and prioritize them to meet specific deadlines.
  • Analyzes business problems and proposes manual and/or data processing solutions. 
  • Travels as necessary; must be able to work occasional weekends.
  • Performs other tasks assigned.

job.title: Finance operations Analyst
job.description:
Job Title: Finance Operations Analyst
Location:Pittsburg, PA
Type: Full Time

Our client which a leading bank is seeking a detail-oriented Finance Operations Analyst to support fast-paced, time-sensitive foreign exchange transactions and client processing activities. This role requires strong knowledge of FX, derivatives, or cash processing, along with the ability to resolve complex operational issues, analyze data, and improve transaction-processing systems.

  • Provides complex analytics and reporting services, working to improve and automate Client Processing systems. 
  • Manages moderate to complex external client issues. 
  • Directly advises other organizational units/teams to ensure timely delivery of service, or resolution of issue.
  • Meets with organizational units/teams to ensure problems and issues are being addressed appropriately and that they are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Participates in product development, product enhancement, and system testing to ensure that products continue to accurately and efficiently process high value transactions. 
  • Solves complex problems based on an understanding and knowledge of the intricacies of the system. 
  • Integrates in-depth area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices to provide solutions to internal and external clients. 
  • Provides support to lower level client processing roles.
  • May be responsible for allocating and checking work of other team members. 
  • May be responsible for specific supervisory review, training and approval actions.
  • Contributes to the achievement of related teams objectives
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelors degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
  • 5-7 years of total work experience is preferred. 
  • Experience in Foreign Exchange, Derivatives, or Cash processing is highly preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety and operational excellence
  • Flexibility to support varying schedules or shifts as business needs require

job.title: Assembler
job.description:
Assembler

Join a dynamic team dedicated to precision and excellence as an Assembler, where your skills contribute directly to the safety and reliability of aircraft instruments used worldwide. In this role, you’ll work on the assembly and final testing of innovative avionics and aircraft components, ensuring each product meets the highest standards of quality and performance. Your meticulous attention to detail and mechanical aptitude will play a vital part in keeping pilots and passengers safely flying.

Required Skills:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of two years’ electronics education, training, or equivalent experience
  • At least one year of hands-on assembly experience with avionic equipment such as pressure gauges, batteries, and inverters
  • Proficiency with hand tools and electronic testing equipment
  • Solid understanding of advanced analog and digital electronics
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven mindset
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
Nice to Have Skills:

  • PCB soldering proficiency (training available if needed)
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED, supplemented by at least two years of electronics training or equivalent work experience
  • One or more years specifically in avionic assembly
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks with high precision
  • Good eye-hand coordination and dexterity
  • Physical ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs occasionally
  • Comfort with handling small objects and using fine tools like screwdrivers, tweezers, and wire cutters
If you’re passionate about contributing to high-quality aerospace manufacturing and thrive in a detail-oriented environment, we want to hear from you! Take the next step in your career—apply today and help keep the world flying safe!

job.title: Subscriber Communications Designer
job.description:
Subscriber Communications Designer Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Subscriber Communications Designer to join our global entertainment client. This role will focus on the design and production of high-volume digital communications supporting subscriber lifecycle marketing, including weekly newsletters, email campaigns, in-app messaging, and push notifications. The ideal candidate will have 2–5 years of digital production or communication design experience, exceptional Photoshop skills, and a strong portfolio demonstrating typography, visual hierarchy, image compositing, and pixel-perfect execution. This is a hands-on production role requiring someone who can manage multiple projects simultaneously, quickly incorporate feedback, and consistently execute within established brand guidelines.

Title: Subscriber Communications Designer
Compensation: $35-43/hr
Type: 2-Year Contract
Industry: Entertainment / Digital Media

Overview Yoh is seeking a Subscriber Communications Designer to support a high-volume lifecycle marketing and subscriber communications team within a global entertainment organization.

The Designer will primarily be responsible for producing weekly subscriber newsletters and other static digital marketing assets, including email, in-app, and push communications. At any given time, the Designer may be managing 2–4 newsletters in different stages of production, requiring excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to move quickly between projects.

This role will partner closely with Art Directors and cross-functional stakeholders to execute creative against established brand systems. The successful candidate should be comfortable receiving multiple rounds of feedback, adapting quickly to changing direction, and independently carrying projects through production with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and produce high-quality digital assets for subscriber lifecycle marketing campaigns, including email newsletters, in-app messaging, and push communications.
  • Produce and manage multiple weekly newsletters, often supporting 2–4 projects simultaneously at different stages of development.
  • Partner closely with Art Directors to translate creative direction into polished, production-ready marketing assets.
  • Apply established brand guidelines while maintaining consistency across typography, imagery, layout, and overall visual presentation.
  • Manipulate, composite, resize, and adapt key art and other visual assets for a variety of digital formats.
  • Create pixel-perfect Photoshop compositions with strong attention to detail.
  • Version and iterate creative assets across different campaigns, messages, audiences, and placements.
  • Incorporate stakeholder and creative feedback efficiently through multiple rounds of revisions.
  • Contribute creative concepts and design solutions for larger subscriber and lifecycle marketing initiatives.
  • Maintain organized project files, layers, naming conventions, and production assets for internal team members, agencies, and external partners.
  • Manage deadlines across multiple concurrent assignments in a fast-paced production environment.
