job.title: Associate Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Associate Cloud Engineer (AWS) 📍 Farmers Branch, TX | Direct Hire

💻 Hybrid Schedule: 3 Days Onsite for the First 2 Months, Then Fully Remote

☁️ Build the cloud. Automate the future. Work from home. Are you passionate about AWS, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and solving complex technical challenges? We're partnering with a growing organization in Farmers Branch, TX to find an Associate Cloud Engineer who is ready to take ownership of cloud infrastructure, improve operational efficiency, and help support mission-critical systems in a modern AWS environment.
This is an outstanding opportunity for a cloud professional looking to expand their expertise across AWS services, DevOps practices, automation, security, and infrastructure engineering. You'll work closely with development, security, and infrastructure teams to build scalable solutions, support cloud operations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Even better? The position offers a hybrid onboarding period of 3 days onsite per week for the first two months, allowing you to build relationships and learn the environment, before transitioning to a fully remote schedule.

If you're excited by automation, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, cloud security, and troubleshooting enterprise-scale systems, this could be the next great step in your career.

Position: Associate Cloud Engineer (AWS) Location: Farmers Branch, TX
Type: Direct Hire
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days onsite for first 2 months), then Fully Remote
 
Responsibilities
  • Deploy, administer, and support AWS infrastructure and services across multiple environments.
  • Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation and/or Terraform.
  • Build and improve automation scripts that reduce manual operational work.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, and application issues, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Support and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Monitor environments using CloudWatch and related tooling; respond to performance, availability, and security issues.
  • Help implement and maintain AWS security controls and identity management (IAM).
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, upgrades, and production support, including executing DR procedures and runbooks.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with software development, security, and infrastructure teams.
 Requirements
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience supporting AWS infrastructure in production.
  • You've written and modified IaC templates and understand what they deploy (CloudFormation or Terraform).
  • Working knowledge of AWS core services: compute, storage, databases, networking, and security.
  • Scripting ability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell — you've automated operational tasks, not just modify/run existing scripts.
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch, PagerDuty or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated solid troubleshooting instincts — you can walk us through a problem you diagnosed and how you approached it.
  • Experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines.
  • Comfort with Git-based workflows.
  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate Certification and/or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Certification (REQUIRED)
  • Exposure to multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and/or Control Tower.
  • Experience with cloud governance, cost optimization, and security controls.
  • Foundational awareness of AWS Generative AI services (such as Amazon Bedrock) and their cost implications.
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity planning within AWS.
  • Microsoft certification/s and/or experience supporting Windows workloads in cloud.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline (equivalent experience accepted in place of a degree).
  • Able to participate in monthly IT maintenance and Development team code promotions (off-hours and weekends).
  • Qualified candidates mut not NOW or in the FUTURE require sponsorhip.
  • Weekly On-call, rotation is every 6 weeks.

job.title: Senior Azure .NET Developer
job.description:
Senior Azure .NET Developer
irving, TX (Hybrid)
Direct Hire

Position Summary
As an experienced Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and modern application architecture, with deep expertise in .NET, Azure technologies, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Beyond technical execution, this role calls for someone who takes full ownership and accountability for outcomes — running toward problems, especially in production, rather than waiting to be asked. You will understand enterprise requirements end-to-end and think several steps ahead to design solutions that stand the test of time. You will act as a hands-on architect and the team's go-to technical resource, reasoning through trade-offs with data and bringing well-communicated recommendations to the Senior Management and architecture team.
What This Role Requires
  • Hands-On Ownership: Personally designs, builds, reviews, troubleshoots, and supports critical components — this is a hands-on technical lead role, not a coordination-only architect position.
  • Decision-Ready Judgment: Frames problems with supporting data, weighs tradeoffs, and brings a clear recommended path with business and technical impact — not just options.
  • Go-To Resource: The person developers and stakeholders bring hard technical questions to — across Azure and C#/.NET — and trust to give a clear, confident answer.
  • Constructive Challenge: Pushes back constructively on weak assumptions and shortcuts, balancing delivery urgency with long-term maintainability.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes beyond code complete: requirements clarity, dependencies, test readiness, release planning, observability, rollback, documentation, and hypercare.
  • Force Multiplier: Builds reusable patterns, standards, templates, and runbooks, and develops secondary ownership so critical knowledge is never a single point of failure.
  • AI-Forward: Actively explores, adopts, and introduces AI-driven SDLC practices — then drives their adoption across the team, validating all AI-generated output through rigorous human review and testing.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Requirements & End-to-End Ownership
  • Understand requirements in full enterprise context — source-of-truth decisions, upstream/downstream systems, business rules, data ownership, security, and support impact.
  • Lead technical discovery into solution designs, technical stories, acceptance criteria, dependency and data mappings, exception scenarios, estimates, risks, and implementation plans.
  • Own delivery from design through testing, deployment, production validation, support transition, and continuous improvement — escalating risks early with options and recommendations.
  • Assess scope changes for architecture, schedule, testing, data, dependency, and operational impact before committing.
Architecture & Technical Direction
  • Own Azure and C#/.NET architecture, implementation, and engineering standards, aligning key architecture decisions with the Senior Manager and architecture team.
  • Design cloud-native, API-led, event-driven, and data-integration solutions; document decisions, alternatives, and tradeoffs in language suited to developers, leadership, and business partners.
  • Evaluate scalability, security, resiliency, performance, observability, maintainability, cost, and supportability before implementation.
  • Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and feedback; establish patterns for error handling, retries, idempotency, and reusable integration components.
Hands-On Engineering
  • Build industry-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, engineered to meet sub-150ms API response targets.
  • Must have strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps/AKS, API Management, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure DevOps.
  • Apply strong practices for asynchronous processing, concurrency, dependency injection, authentication/authorization, data modeling, API contracts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter recovery.
  • Front-end contribution (React.js, Next.js) as needed is a plus, not required — primary depth stays in backend and integration engineering.
Performance, Data & Cost Engineering
  • Diagnose end-to-end performance using correlated telemetry across edge, API, compute, messaging, database, and batch layers.
  • Use workload evidence — latency, throughput, error/retry rates, CPU/memory, Cosmos DB RU consumption and partitioning — to guide decisions rather than guesswork.
  • Tune Cosmos DB partitioning, throughput, and indexing; balance real-time and batch workloads without defaulting to capacity increases.
  • Evaluate Azure cost and capacity tradeoffs, and recommend savings without weakening reliability.
DevSecOps & Release Engineering
  • Champion automated unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance testing with meaningful coverage as part of CI/CD quality gates.
  • Build and improve Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or equivalent) for repeatable application and platform deployments.
  • Embed secure engineering practices: managed identity, secrets management, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
Observability, Reliability & Production Support
  • Design structured logging, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, metrics, and alerts that minimize noise and speed root-cause analysis.
  • Define production-readiness criteria, runbooks, failure modes, and post-deployment validation.
  • DR Champion: Own disaster recovery strategy end-to-end — RPO/RTO targets, failover, backup/restore, recovery automation, and periodic DR testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigation with urgency, converting lessons learned into durable engineering improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, remaining available to support production issues as needed.
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Be a front-runner in adopting approved AI-assisted practices across the SDLC — planning, coding, testing, documentation, review, and troubleshooting.
  • Validate all AI-generated output through human review, automated testing, and security controls.
  • Build reusable prompts, repository instructions, and guardrails that capture team learning and promote consistent, secure AI usage.
  • Track and communicate AI's impact on delivery speed, quality, and incident resolution.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Partner with product, QA, security, infrastructure, data, support, and onshore/offshore engineering teams.
  • Lead with empathy and accountability: listen, explain reasoning, challenge respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • Provide concise, accurate status, risk, and completion updates, keeping delivery status current.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong depth in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure backend/integration services.
  • Proven, end-to-end ownership of production Azure solutions — from requirements and architecture through deployment, observability, and support.
  • Demonstrated expertise with cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-system failure handling.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Cosmos DB, including production troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with automated testing, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and observability tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct design/code reviews, communicate tradeoffs, and lead through ambiguity.
  • Practical, responsible experience using AI development tools, including output validation and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate; Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, high-availability architecture, distributed tracing, and production on-call support.
  • Cosmos DB partitioning/RU optimization, Azure performance engineering, and FinOps practices.
  • Experience standardizing AI-assisted engineering workflows or reusable development automation.
  • Experience in retail, distribution, supply chain, or heavy-duty aftermarket domains.
Success Measures
  • Risks, dependencies, and non-functional requirements are surfaced before development and QA.
  • Solutions reach production with automated tests, observability, documented support ownership, and validated rollback/recovery.
  • Technical debt is prevented where practical, or explicitly documented and bounded when intentionally accepted.
  • Develops clean designs, and reusable engineering assets grow over time.
  • AI-assisted development shows measurable improvement while maintaining human validation and quality.

job.title: ServiceNow UI/UX Developer
job.description:
ServiceNow UI/UX Developer 

*Looking for a ServiceNow Developer with a creative mindset and UI/UX experience on the design side!

  • Remote opportunity (within the United States & must be able to work PST time zone) 
  • Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!! (If you are a third party employer, please DO NOT CALL ME. Thank you)
  • 6 month contract (great potential to extend)
  • $80-100/hr on W2 (contingent on experience)

Sony Interactive (PlayStation) is seeking a UI/UX Developer with strong ServiceNow platform expertise to enhance the end-to-end user experience of our ServiceNow-based portals and workspaces. This role is responsible for designing and delivering intuitive, accessible, and scalable digital experiences that supports end users in the Sony Interactive Entertainment ecosystem.
This role is central to delivering modern, intuitive, and scalable UI/UX solutions on the ServiceNow platform. A successful candidate will act as an expert in tools like UI Builder, with the ability to customize out-of-the-box experiences and create new workspaces and portals from scratch. 

Key Responsibilities
User Experience Strategy & Design
  • Own the UX design strategy, ensuring alignment with SIE experience principles, brand guidelines, and accessibility standards.
  • Translate business requirements and user needs into user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and final UI designs.
  • Conduct usability assessments, user feedback reviews, and journey analysis to identify friction points and drive continuous experience improvement.
  • Define and maintain reusable UX patterns and standards across ServiceNow HR and employee-facing experiences.
ServiceNow UI Development & Implementation
  • Design and build responsive, user-friendly interfaces using ServiceNow UI Builder, Service Portal, Employee Center, and/or other approaches.
  • Develop and customize UI components, widgets, layouts, and themes using HTML, CSS, Glide Api JavaScript, and ServiceNow APIs.
  • Ensure consistent interaction patterns, form behaviour and navigation models across Portals.
  • Optimize UI performance, accessibility (WCAG 2.1+), and cross-browser/device compatibility.
  • Manage and maintain the user interface layer of ServiceNow applications.

Platform Delivery & Engineering Collaboration
  • Partner closely with ServiceNow developers, architects, and product owners to ensure UI designs integrate seamlessly with workflows, data models, and platform capabilities.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, and sprint planning to ensure UX work is properly scoped and delivered.
  • Support ServiceNow upgrades and platform changes, proactively identifying and mitigating UI/UX impacts.
  • Troubleshoot UI defects and usability issues, delivering scalable and supportable solutions.

Required Qualifications
  • 3–5+ years of experience in UI/UX design and front-end development, with 2–3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow UI experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow UI Builder, Service Portal, and/or Employee Center frameworks.
  • Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
  • Solid understanding of user-centric design methodologies, usability testing, and accessibility standards (WCAG).
  • Ability to balance design quality with platform constraints, timelines, and delivery priorities.
  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale portals or digital experiences, ideally in HR, recruiting, or employee-facing domains.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with UI design and visualization tools (e.g., Figma, Miro).
    Ability to balance design quality with platform constraints, timelines, and delivery priorities.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

job.title: Embedded Vehicle Access Software Developer
job.description:
Embedded Vehicle Access Software Developer

We're looking for a skilled Embedded Vehicle Access Software Developer to help design and build vehicle access capabilities that allow vehicles, mobile devices, and wireless systems to interact securely and seamlessly. You'll take ownership of software for vehicle access systems, spanning Body Control Modules (BCMs), embedded platforms, and wireless technologies, to deliver best-in-class Digital Key experiences.

Responsibilities
  • Design and build embedded software for Vehicle Access systems deployed on ECUs and real-time embedded platforms.
  • Build out and maintain Digital Key capabilities aligned with Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC) standards.
  • Develop vehicle access software leveraging Bluetooth, Ultra-Wideband (UWB), NFC, and RF communication technologies.
  • Partner closely with systems, hardware, validation, cybersecurity, and mobile app teams to deliver complete vehicle access solutions.
  • Write and refine embedded software in C, using Python to automate testing and validation workflows.
  • Shape software architecture, interfaces, and communication frameworks connecting vehicle systems to external devices.
  • Assist with vehicle integration, debugging, and system bring-up on both prototype and production vehicles.
  • Diagnose and resolve intricate software, connectivity, and RF issues spanning vehicle and mobile ecosystems.
  • Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions that keep vehicle access architecture scalable and dependable.
  • Champion software quality via rigorous testing, automation, and root-cause investigation across the development lifecycle.
  • Make effective use of AI-powered development tools (such as VS Code with GitHub Copilot or other AI assistants) to speed up coding, reviews, debugging, documentation, and test creation — while carefully vetting all AI-generated output for compliance with automotive safety, security, and coding requirements (e.g., MISRA).

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a comparable discipline.
  • 5+ years building embedded software professionally.
  • Solid command of Embedded C programming.
  • Proven Python scripting and automation skills.
  • Direct experience with sophisticated embedded software projects — for instance, Vehicle Access systems or Digital Key technology.
  • Familiarity working with industry standards, such as those from the Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC).
  • Solid understanding of Bluetooth, UWB, NFC, RF communication, and wireless connectivity architecture.
  • Background developing software for automotive ECUs and real-time embedded systems.
  • Understanding of vehicle communication architectures and embedded development practices.
  • Skill in diagnosing and resolving issues spanning hardware, firmware, and system layers.
  • Practical experience with modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g., VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to boost coding efficiency, speed up debugging, and support documentation/test generation — paired with good judgment on responsibly applying AI-generated results.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Automotive background implementing CCC Digital Key vehicle access technology.
  • Experience building software for Body Control Modules (BCM) or Vehicle Access ECUs.
  • Awareness of cybersecurity principles tied to vehicle access and secure authentication.
  • Exposure to CAN, Automotive Ethernet, diagnostics, and other vehicle communication protocols.
  • Background in vehicle integration, validation, and launch efforts.
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux and RTOS-based systems.
  • Knowledge of ISO 26262, ASPICE, MISRA, or other automotive software development standards.
  • Track record of shaping or contributing to team guidelines around the safe, efficient use of AI coding tools in safety-critical or regulated software settings.

job.title: Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer - Injection Molding
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer for our client in San Diego. In this role, you will serve as a primary quality lead on cross-functional teams supporting new materials, supplier qualifications, and supplier-related changes. The Senior Supplier Quality Engineer will be responsible for developing and maintaining material specifications, managing supplier quality and performance, conducting supplier audits, leading investigations and corrective actions, and ensuring compliance with internal and external quality requirements, standards, and regulations.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive Quality Assurance and Supplier Management experience and must have experience with injection molding and plastics. 

Industry:  Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite, Monday - Friday 
Compensation: $116,000 - 145,000 DOE
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Serve as the primary Quality lead on cross-functional teams supporting new materials, supplier qualifications, supplier changes, and supplier management activities.
  • Develop and execute qualification programs for new materials and suppliers using a risk-based approach.
  • Evaluate and monitor supplier risk levels to ensure suppliers and materials meet company quality requirements.
  • Develop and execute the annual supplier audit program using a risk-based approach and provide guidance to ensure successful completion.
  • Independently conduct internal and external supplier audits, approve audit reports, and ensure associated nonconformances and corrective actions are appropriately addressed.
  • Lead investigations of low-, medium-, and high-risk material and supplier-related issues, determine root cause, and develop appropriate corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Manage Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), including communication of nonconformances, investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness assessment.
  • Review, approve, and monitor supplier qualification and performance scorecards and ensure follow-up actions are completed within established timelines.
  • Partner with suppliers to review and approve required quality documentation, including supplier questionnaires and improvement plans.
  • Develop, monitor, and trend Supplier Quality System metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Create, review, and approve Supplier Quality procedures and documentation to ensure compliance with company requirements and applicable regulations.
  • Review and assess supplier Quality Agreements to support timely supplier qualification.
  • Independently author, review, and approve raw material specifications to support supplier and material qualification.
  • Ensure appropriate material specifications are developed, maintained, reviewed, and approved.
  • Lead critical supplier quality issues and stakeholder meetings, document meeting outcomes, and ensure timely completion of action items.
  • Assess supplier change notifications and provide technical recommendations regarding potential impacts to product quality and the Quality Management System.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for supplier-related change control processes and monitor implementation of approved changes.
  • Provide Quality Assurance representation on projects involving new materials, material changes, and supplier management.
  • Develop and support Quality System and procedural training programs for employees.
  • Train and mentor team members within and outside of the Supplier Quality organization.
  • Host third-party audits conducted by regulatory agencies, notified bodies, and business partners, including FDA inspections.
  • Apply appropriate statistical methods and data analysis techniques to investigations, corrective actions, supplier performance, and continuous improvement activities.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline required.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant Quality Assurance experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of Supplier Management experience.
  • Experience with injection molding and plastics is required, including direct technical, maintenance, and/or quality experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) processes and procedures.
  • Previous experience conducting and supporting supplier and Quality System audits.
  • Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, SCARs, root cause investigations, CAPA, and change control.
  • Prior experience working with an electronic document management system required.
  • Technical writing, trend analysis, and project leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience implementing process improvements and analyzing quality trends is preferred.
  • SAP experience is a plus.
  • Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated ability to independently develop SOPs, forms, technical assessments, and risk assessments.
  • Strong knowledge of materials, formulations, and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze and trend data using statistical methods and software.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of a cross-functional organization.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external suppliers to develop and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Ability to train, mentor, and provide technical guidance to others.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Office, manufacturing, and supplier-facing work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
  • May require extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking while supporting manufacturing activities, audits, and supplier quality initiatives.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, quality records, and manufacturing data.
  • May require travel to supplier locations or other company facilities to conduct audits and support supplier quality activities.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer - Embedded Platform Software
job.description:
Staff Software Engineer - Embedded Platform Software 

We are seeking a Staff Embedded Platform Software Engineer to join our ADAS / Autonomous Driving Platform Software team. This role is for a senior technical leader who will define, architect, and deliver secure, high performance embedded platforms that underpin next-generation automotive systems.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Linux/QNX BSP development, hardware bring-up, and embedded security, along with the ability to lead complex technical initiatives across hardware, systems, and software teams.

Key Responsibilities
• Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for embedded platform software used in ADAS and autonomous driving systems
• Own and drive end-to-end platform initiatives from early bring-up through production readiness
• Lead board bring-up, SoC enablement, and low-level driver architecture for critical peripherals
• Define and guide camera bring-up, ISP integration, and video pipeline architecture
• Architect and oversee secure video streaming solutions, including video codecs and secure RTP pipelines
• Partner with hardware, systems, safety, security, and application teams to resolve cross-domain technical challenges
• Influence platform standards, best practices, and long-term technical roadmaps
• Mentor and technically guide engineers, raising overall team capability

Required Qualifications
• 8+ years of experience in embedded software development for complex, safety- or performance critical systems
• Expert-level proficiency in C/C++
• Deep hands-on experience with Linux and/or QNX kernel, BSP, and platform software development
• Strong background in board bring-up and device driver development, including I2C, UART, SPI, PCIe, RGMII, SGMII, and camera ISPs
• Experience working with real-time operating systems and real-time constraints

Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced C++ system-level and application-level design experience
• Proven experience contributing to ADAS or autonomous driving platforms
• Strong ability to read, interpret, and influence hardware schematics, datasheets, and system designs
• Experience with bootloaders, secure boot, firmware update strategies, and UDS diagnostics
• Deep understanding of embedded security architectures, including cryptographic hardware, key management, certificate lifecycles, and secure provisioning
• Experience influencing technical decisions across teams without direct authority

job.title: Semiconductor Engineering Technician /Austin, Texas-$1500 Sign on Bonus after 6months
job.description:
Semiconductor Engineering Technicians Intermediate/Advanced are needed for an 18 month contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Austin, Texas. Candidates must take direction from management staff (Physicists and Engineers) and be able to independently provide expertise to accomplish assigned tasks.  The successful candidate(s) must have the ability to communicate effectively and interact with a diverse project team to collect, compile, maintain and interpret data and test results accurately.


Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years experience testing on electro-mechanical equipment



Pay Rate: $23 to $26 per hour



Bonus payout structure:

  • $500 after successful completion of 90 days
  • $1,000 after successful completion of 180 days


What You Will Be Doing

  • Performs moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.
  • Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.
  • Works from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform moderate testing and troubleshooting.
  • Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills. Assists in revising, developing and implementing department procedures.
  • May perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic & vacuum and process testing on platforms to Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.
  • Observes all safety standards. Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment. Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices. Promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.
  • Becomes familiar with current manufacturing and/or engineering processes and stays informed of any changes in procedures. Assists in the correction of problems.
  • Performs necessary rework and assists in determining remedies for malfunctions and generates Quality Notifications.
 

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

 

  • Positive Attitude
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Good Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Team Player
  • Ability to Accept and Learn from Criticism
  • Flexibility/Adaptability
  • Works Well Under Pressure

Opportunity is Calling, Apply Now!

Various shifts

Overtime required

Open to working weekend hours

job.title: Materials Coordinator - SF Swing Shift - Monday-Friday. (10AM-6:30PM)
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - San Francisco: Monday-Friday. 10:00AM-6:30PM.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements, and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive parts specialist, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Experienced in positions such as – parts advisor, parts specialist, inventory technician, materials handlers, parts coordinator, etc.
• Experience with a DMS (Dealer Management System) – CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, etc. (SAP experience would be great but not required).
• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: WiFi/CPE Validation Engineer (Octoscope/Veriwave)
job.description:
WiFi/CPE Validation Engineer

Looking for a WiFi Validation Engineer to handle performance testing for routers and extenders. This person must have experience with Octoscope and/or Veriwave - RF Chambers, and be able to write TR-069/TR-181 related scripts. (Octoscope is for OTA testing and Veriwave is for conductive testing).

 

Required:

• Previous experience with WiFi performance testing is a must have.

• Octoscope and/or Veriwave is a must have. Octoscope is for OTA testing and Veriwave is for conductive testing.

• Ability to write shell scripts to validate CPE (i.e. TR-069 routers) on the network is a must have. TR-069, TR69, TR-69 OR TR181, TR-181. ACS (Auto configuration server) is another good key word for this).

• Solid knowledge of RF concepts – Splitters, attenuators, antennas, RF shielded box, etc.

• Experience with lab test equipment – Spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, oscilloscopes, etc.

• Good knowledge of TCP-IP, & L2 networking / switches, Wireshark debugging tool.

• Ability to customize scripts & run experiments per vendor – ports, wifi radios, SSID packets.

 

Pluses:

• Background in SW automation using tools like Python & Expect or other.

• Familiar with L3-networking / routers is a plus.

• Generate TPut/KPI/and other performance metrics/statistics for the devices being tested, compile test reports, in order to help prepare presentations.

 

#Dice-SPG

#Zip-SPG

#Mon-SPG

#CB-SPG

#IND-SPG

job.title: Onsite Materials Buyer-Gloucester, MA
job.description:
Onsite Materials Buyer needed for a 12 month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Gloucester, Massachusetts.

 
Pay Rate: $34 to $39 per hour



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Negotiates pricing and other terms of purchase under supervision. Manage none strategic suppliers (none QFM)? $5M.  Quotes materials; procures materials, components, equipment and services at the lowest cost consistent with consideration of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need.  Expedites and ensures the timely receipt of materials.
  • Works with engineering and MPM or SCM to recommend new suppliers.  Issues RFQs, analyzes proposals, negotiates prices and delivery, issues and/or adjusts purchase orders in a timely manner.  Follows-up on orders, verifies delivery, approves payment, and maintains necessary records.  Negotiates vendor contracts, as appropriate.  Follows purchasing business processes.
  • Leads purchasing activities with manufacturing and engineering departments to maintain inventory at planned levels.
  • Leads problem resolution for material related accounting and receiving issues

Functional Knowledge
  • Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines
  • Understanding of supply chain processes and purchasing strategies.
  • Knowledge of inventory management and logistics.
  • Familiarity with contract management and vendor relations.
  •  Strong communication skills to collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.


Business Expertise
  • Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market
  •  Significant experience in purchasing or procurement, often ranging from 3 to 5 years.
  • Experience in a similar industry or with specific products relevant to the hiring organization may be required.



   

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 


Leadership
  • Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements


Problem Solving
  • Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

Impact
  • Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies


Interpersonal Skills
  • Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus
  • Strong negotiation skills to secure favorable terms and pricing.
  • Excellent analytical skills to assess vendors and evaluate product quality and cost-effectiveness.
  • Proficiency in procurement software SAP/SCV/ARIBA
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  •  Motivation, initiative, collaboration, connectivity and coaching
   

Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:

  • A bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain management, procurement, or a related field is typically preferred
  • Required: Data analysis, inventory management, procurement processes, and supply chain technologies Computer Skills : Required:  procurement software SAP/SCV/ARIBA Soft Skills: Required: effective communication, negotiation, critical thinking, and problem-solving
  • 3 to five years of experience

job.title: Sr Vice President, Infrastructure Engineer w strong Mainframe - Jersey City, Pittsburg, LM
job.description:
Join Our Client Team as Senior Vice President, Infrastructure Engineer – Mainframe Focus

Are you a seasoned infrastructure expert with deep roots in IBM Mainframe technology? We’re seeking a dynamic Senior Vice President to lead our client's infrastructure engineering initiatives, with a strong emphasis on Mainframe platform.  This pivotal role offers an exciting opportunity to influence enterprise-wide technology resiliency, modernization, and operational excellence at a top-tier organization.


Job Details: 

4 days Onsite in Jersey City/Pittsburg PA or Lake Mary FL
Permanent Full time employment
$150,000-$180,000 Base 

Infrastructure Engineering & Platform Support

  • Provide senior-level support and engineering expertise for IBM Mainframe infrastructure and associated technologies.
  • Maintain platform stability, availability, performance, and resiliency across production and non-production environments.
  • Support system software upgrades, maintenance activities, platform enhancements, and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Perform complex troubleshooting and root cause analysis for infrastructure and platform-related issues.
  • Lead recovery efforts during critical incidents and major outage situations.
  • Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, and support standards.
Operational Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, efficiency, automation, and risk reduction.
  • Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and infrastructure optimization activities.
  • Monitor platform health and proactively identify operational risks.
  • Partner with service management teams to improve incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ensure operational readiness for new technologies and platform enhancements.
Technology Strategy & Modernization

  • Support long-term technology strategies focused on resiliency, modernization, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices.
  • Participate in infrastructure transformation initiatives and platform optimization efforts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, monitoring, and engineering processes.
Risk & Control Management

  • Ensure compliance with enterprise risk management standards and technology controls.
  • Support audit activities, regulatory examinations, and control reviews.
  • Participate in disaster recovery testing and resiliency exercises.
  • Maintain adherence to cybersecurity and operational risk requirements.
Technical Leadership

  • Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Provide technical leadership across cross-functional initiatives.
  • Partner with senior technology leaders on strategic priorities and operational improvements.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for mainframe infrastructure technologies.
Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 12+ years of infrastructure engineering experience within large enterprise environments.
  • 8+ years of hands-on IBM Mainframe engineering and support experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting mission-critical production platforms operating in a 24x7 environment.
  • Experience managing complex technical incidents and operational recovery events.
  • Experience working within highly regulated financial services or similarly complex industries preferred.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Instrumentation (NPI + Sustaining) Yoh is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our biotech instrumentation client, supporting new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining engineering efforts for their state-of-the-art platforms. The ideal individual will have strong competency in SolidWorks and expert knowledge of GD&T, with experience supporting mechanical design development, troubleshooting, and documentation for complex instrumentation.

Industry: Biotech / Instrumentation
Location: Pleasanton, CA

Responsibilities 
  • Support mechanical design efforts for NPI and sustaining engineering projects, including development, verification, validation, and production transfer.
  • Work with R&D, manufacturing, and service teams to bring new instrument platforms from prototype to production.
  • Assist in design updates by analyzing field issues, reviewing return material data, and driving improvements to reliability and manufacturability.
  • Support root cause analysis activities and help implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with internal teams and contract manufacturers.
  • Perform hands-on troubleshooting and evaluation of mechanical, optical, and electromechanical subsystems.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, including BOMs, ECOs, risk assessments, and updates in PLM/ERP systems.
  • Prepare technical reports and documentation to communicate findings across cross-functional teams.
Required Skills (Must-Haves)
  • Solidworks, expert knowledge of GD&T
  • Machine shop or hands-on fabrication experience.
  • Manufacturing or production support experience.
  • Experience with NPI processes, pilot builds, or design transfer.
  • Familiarity with optics, motion systems, or electromechanical assemblies.
  • Experience troubleshooting liquid handling or automation systems.
  • Exposure to DFM/DFA, ISO 13485, FDA-regulated environments.
  • Experience with reliability testing (MTBF/MTTR) and FMEA.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Jira, Confluence, Oracle ERP, or Arena PLM.
  • Strong collaboration skills across R&D, operations, supply chain, and service teams.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Land Survey Crew Chief - Fort Lauderdale, FL
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Survey Crew Chief to oversee survey operations for our Civil Engineering client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of overall surveying experience, prior experience as a Crew Chief, and live within a commutable distance to the office Fort Lauderdale, FL for an onsite environment.

 


See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

 

Title: Land Survey Crew Chief

Compensation: $30.00-$40.00/hour (depending on experience level)

Type: Full Time

Industry: Civil Engineering

 

Responsibilities:

·      Lead field operations using advanced equipment such as Trimble, Leica, and Spectre robotic total stations, GPS RTK Units, and 3D Laser Scanners.

·      Manage data collection efficiently, ensuring seamless transfer and collaboration with office staff.

·      Maintain accurate documentation and organization of project files upon completion.

·      Utilize map interpretation skills to navigate projects effectively, including scaling drawings and deciphering symbols.

·      Guide the team with your comprehensive knowledge of survey types and their purposes.

·      Foster open communication with the Assistant/Project Manager and team members to address project needs promptly.

·      Take responsibility for equipment maintenance, ensuring optimal performance for each project.

·      Demonstrate initiative in optimizing task execution to enhance efficiency and productivity.

·      Utilize general computer applications proficiently to streamline surveying processes.

·      Embrace opportunities for growth and development through training and educational initiatives.

·      Be flexible to work overtime and travel with overnight stays as required by project demands.

·      Contribute your insights and creativity to our team culture, driving innovation and collaboration.

·      Demonstrate reliability and punctuality, essential qualities for success in this role.



 

Qualifications:

·      5+ years of surveying experience in AutoCAD Civil 3D, with demonstrated proficiency in producing clean and accurate plan presentations and 1 to 2 years of Florida construction experience

·      Strong math skills to ensure precise measurement and calculation in surveying tasks.

·      Proven record of producing clean and accurate plan presentations, showcasing attention to detail and quality.

·      Knowledge of field survey operations, as well as the engineering and construction industry, to effectively coordinate survey activities with project requirements.

·      Excellent organizational and communication skills, facilitating effective collaboration with team members and clients.

·      Ability to learn new software and technologies in a timely manner, adapting to evolving industry tools and methodologies.

·      Proficient with MS Word and Excel, enabling efficient documentation and data management processes.

job.title: Intermediate/Advanced Warehouse Materials Coordinator
job.description:
Intermediate/Advanced Materials Coordinator needed for an 12-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate $23 to $28 per hour depending on experience
 



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change



What You Will Be Doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Prioritize daily activities within the Stockroom and Materials department to support production schedules and customer requirements.
  • Provide support at the Westford offsite warehouse as needed, including order picking and general materials coverage.
  • Investigate order picking issues, inventory discrepancies, cycle count variances, and nonconforming material. Perform cycle counts to verify inventory accuracy and maintain inventory integrity.
  • Locate, audit, transfer, and stage kits or materials to support production and shipping requirements.
  • Receive incoming materials, complete inventory transactions, and update inventory records, shortage reports, and related documentation using Made2Manage (M2M) or other inventory systems.
  • Monitor and maintain shortage reports to help ensure material availability for production.
  • Coordinate the processing and disposition of nonconforming material in accordance with established procedures.
  • Work with management to minimize excess inventory by relocating, consolidating, or disposing of material as directed.
  • Organize, consolidate, and maintain stockroom locations to maximize storage capacity, improve inventory accuracy, and support efficient material flow.
  • Assist with expediting material deliveries from suppliers when requested by management.
  • Train and certify Material Coordinators on departmental processes, procedures, and safe work practices.
  • Follow established business processes and maintain accurate documentation for inventory and material transactions.
  • Support inventory control initiatives by identifying excess or obsolete material and assisting with rework, transfer, or scrap activities as directed.
  • Operate powered industrial equipment, including pallet jacks, electric pallet jacks, after certification.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures and actively contribute to maintaining a safe work environment.
  • Provide cross functional coverage for Inventory Control, Receiving, the Stockroom, and Production Control during planned or unplanned absences.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • This position requires the ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday. Regular physical activity includes bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting materials, and working in confined spaces.
  • The role also requires the ability to distinguish between colors, work in a manufacturing environment with varying noise levels, use hand and power tools, and safely operate powered industrial equipment, including forklifts.
  • Some work may be performed in a clean room environment. When required, employees must wear appropriate personal protective equipment, which may include coveralls, hoods, boot covers, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, face shields, and other required protective equipment.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in stockroom operations, inventory control, material handling, and established departmental procedures.
  • Applies standard processes and sound judgment to complete assigned responsibilities accurately and efficiently.
  • Understands how the Materials department supports Manufacturing, Planning, Purchasing, Shipping, Receiving, and other operational functions.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Outlook and has basic to intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Comfortable working within ERP and inventory management systems, including Made2Manage (M2M).
  • Provides day to day guidance and support to less experienced team members.
  • Assists with training, onboarding, and certification of Material Coordinators while promoting consistent work practices.
  • Investigates inventory and material related issues, identifies root causes, and resolves routine and moderately complex problems by applying established procedures and sound judgment.
  • Escalates issues appropriately when additional support or direction is needed.
  • Communicates effectively with Planning, Production, Inventory Control, Receiving, Shipping, Purchasing, and other departments to ensure material availability and resolve issues.
  • Builds positive working relationships and maintains clear, professional communication





Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Overall Years of experience -2-4
  • Mandatory Skills: Technical/Non-Technical

job.title: Senior / Lead Technical Program Manager – Vehicle Level Software Integration & Test
job.description:
Senior / Lead Technical Program Manager – Vehicle Level Software Integration & Test
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior/Lead Technical Program Manager to lead vehicle-level software integration and test activities across complex, multi-domain vehicle programs. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, systems engineering, and vehicle program management — responsible for orchestrating the integration and validation of software from multiple domains (e.g., ADAS, infotainment, body controls, thermals, motion and powertrain, connectivity, cybersecurity) into a cohesive, validated vehicle-level software release. The TPM will define verification & validation (V&V) strategy for new features, drive execution across the full test hierarchy (pre-merge through vehicle-level), plan and manage vehicle test trips, and ensure the software test fleet is ready to execute — while managing schedule, risk, and cross-functional alignment to ensure software quality, safety, and timely delivery.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
  • 7+ years of experience in software program/project management, systems integration, or V&V, with significant time in automotive or embedded/vehicle software environments.
  • Proven experience creating and executing V&V plans for software features across the full test hierarchy (unit, pre-merge, post-merge, HIL/SIL, vehicle-level).
  • Experience planning and/or supporting vehicle test trips (e.g., winter test, hot weather test) and managing test fleet logistics and readiness.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle software architecture (ECUs, domain controllers, in-vehicle networks such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SOA-based architectures).
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional software integration and test programs with multiple interdependent workstreams.
  • Familiarity with SDLC, Agile/SAFe methodologies, and CI/CD-based test automation for embedded systems.
  • Excellent risk management, prioritization, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to translate technical complexity into clear program status for leadership.
  • Proficiency with program management and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project) and defect/test management systems (e.g., ALM, Polarion).
  • Strong analytical, data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to test sites/trip locations as required.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) and cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434) V&V requirements.
  • Experience with software-defined vehicle (SDV) architectures, OTA update systems, and CI/CD for embedded systems.
  • Experience managing seasonal/climate-based test programs (e.g., winter test in northern climates, hot weather test) including fleet mobilization at remote proving grounds.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), or similar certification.
  • Experience working with global, cross-site engineering teams and Tier 1 suppliers.
  • Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python, shell) for test/integration tooling.
Key Competencies
  • Systems-level thinking with strong technical fluency across hardware-software boundaries
  • Executive-level communication and influence without direct authority
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity across complex, matrixed organizations
  • Strong ownership mindset and bias for action under tight program timelines
  • Strong logistics and cross-functional coordination skills, particularly for time- and location-bound test events

Key Responsibilities
Integration & Program Management
  • Own the end-to-end vehicle-level software integration and test plan, aligning domain-level software delivery schedules with vehicle program milestones (e.g., SOP, Job 1, integration builds, validation events).
  • Coordinate across software domain teams (ADAS, HMI/infotainment, body & chassis, powertrain, connected services, cybersecurity, OTA) to ensure compatible interfaces, dependencies, and release readiness.
  • Coordinate Systems Engineering activities across vehicle domains and organizations to ensure integration requirements are consistently defined and understood.
  • Partner with hardware teams to track ECU/component availability and hardware pedigree, ensuring integration and test schedules account for hardware readiness.
  • Drive the software build and integration cadence, managing bill-of-software (BOS) configurations, release trains, and version control across ECUs/domain controllers.
  • Manage program-level dashboards, metrics, and reporting on integration health, software maturity, defect burn-down, and readiness for key gate reviews.
  • Facilitate technical reviews and readiness assessments (e.g., Integration Readiness Review, Test Readiness Review, Release Readiness Review) with engineering leadership and program stakeholders.
  • Identify and mitigate schedule, technical, and resource risks; escalate proactively with clear options and recommendations.
  • Interface with suppliers and Tier 1 partners on software delivery timing, quality, and integration commitments; manage supplier relationships for software/firmware components, ensuring clear requirements and timely deliveries.
Verification & Validation (V&V) Planning
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive V&V plans for new features and functions, defining acceptance criteria, test coverage, entry/exit criteria, and traceability from requirements through validation.
  • Partner with feature teams, systems engineering, and safety/cybersecurity teams to ensure V&V plans address functional, performance, safety (ISO 26262), and security (ISO/SAE 21434) requirements.
  • Define the test strategy across the full validation hierarchy — unit, pre-merge, post-merge (integration), HIL/SIL bench, and vehicle-level — ensuring appropriate coverage and traceability at each stage.
  • Establish and evolve V&V processes, templates, and governance to scale across concurrent feature workstreams and vehicle programs.
Test Execution Oversight
  • Plan and oversee execution of pre-merge testing (automated gating checks/CI pipelines) to ensure code quality and prevent regression prior to integration.
  • Plan and oversee execution of post-merge/integration testing across domain and cross-domain builds, ensuring timely defect detection and closure before promotion to vehicle-level test.
  • Plan and oversee execution of vehicle-level validation (bench, proving ground, fleet/field testing), coordinating test resources, vehicle availability, and cross-functional support teams.
  • Drive triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution of defects found across all test phases; lead cross-functional defect review boards and daily stand-ups.
  • Track V&V execution metrics (test pass rate, coverage, defect density/aging, escape rate) and report progress and risk to program leadership.
  • Triage defects surfaced from vehicle testing outside the core SIT process — including durability/mileage accumulation, driver fleet testing, and other vehicle test organizations — and coordinate scheduling of fixes with the relevant software domain teams.
  • Partner with software domain teams to build and maintain release checklists, and own release notes for vehicle-level software releases, including documentation of known limitations and workarounds
  • Continuously improve test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling to increase efficiency and coverage across pre-merge, post-merge, and vehicle-level test stages.
Test Trip Planning & Fleet Readiness
  • Plan and manage dedicated vehicle test trips (e.g., winter/cold-climate testing, hot weather/desert testing, high-altitude, durability, and other geographically/environmentally driven validation events), including scope definition, scheduling, logistics, and staffing.
  • Define test trip objectives and exit criteria in coordination with feature and V&V teams, ensuring trip test plans map back to overall software release and validation milestones.
  • Coordinate cross-functional trip logistics — vehicle allocation, travel/site arrangements, tooling/data-logging equipment, and on-site support — partnering with fleet operations, hardware, and facilities teams.
  • Oversee test readiness of the software test vehicle fleet, ensuring vehicles are built with the correct software configuration/BOS, instrumentation, and known-issue status prior to trip departure or test execution.
  • Establish and run fleet readiness reviews/checklists (software load verification, calibration status, defect triage for known issues, safety sign-off) prior to key test events.
  • Track fleet health and availability throughout test trips, managing real-time issue triage, software patch/update deployment to vehicles in the field, and escalation of blocking issues.
  • Capture and report test trip results, lessons learned, and residual risk back into the broader V&V and program risk tracking process.

job.title: Lab Support Engineer
job.description:
Lab Support Engineer
We are seeking a hands-on Lab Support Engineer to support hardware testing, lab automation, robotics, and reliability activities within an engineering development environment. This role combines electro-mechanical testing with LabVIEW/Python automation, data acquisition, automated test systems, and day-to-day lab operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across hardware and software and can troubleshoot complex test setups while supporting multiple development programs.

Scope:
• Set up, configure, and execute hardware reliability, environmental, mechanical, and stress testing.
• Develop, maintain, and execute automated test routines and DAQ sequences using LabVIEW, Python, C++, or similar tools.
• Integrate, program, and troubleshoot robotic fixtures, actuators, PLCs, and automated test stations.
• Configure sensors, instrumentation, drivers, firmware, and network connections supporting laboratory equipment.
• Operate test equipment including thermal/humidity chambers, vibration systems, Instron testers, oscilloscopes, DMMs, DAQs, and related instrumentation.
• Troubleshoot test anomalies, sensor issues, automation failures, and equipment problems.
• Support hardware testing throughout EVT, DVT, and PVT development phases.
• Analyze test data and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate results.
• Develop and maintain SOPs, test procedures, work instructions, and automation documentation.
• Support lab operations including equipment calibration, safety, test-cell organization, and maintenance.

Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of experience in hardware testing, lab automation, instrument control, reliability testing, or test bench development.
• Hands-on experience with LabVIEW for instrument control, sensor interfacing, or automated data acquisition.
• Experience with robotics or automation systems such as robotic arms, linear actuators, PLCs, motor controllers, or automated fixtures.
• Experience with environmental, mechanical, or reliability testing using equipment such as thermal chambers, vibration tables, or Instron systems.
• Experience with electrical instrumentation including oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, sensors, thermocouples, and DAQ systems.
• Experience with Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar scripting/programming tools.
• Strong troubleshooting, data analysis, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings and work hands-on with electro-mechanical test setups.

Pluses:
• CLAD, CLD, or other LabVIEW certification.
• 5+ years of experience with lab automation, robotics, or reliability testing.
• Experience developing custom LabVIEW/Python test GUIs or automated test benches.
• Experience integrating test systems with databases or dashboards.
• Familiarity with RS-232/485, CAN, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, GPIB, I2C, SPI, or similar communication protocols.
• Experience supporting fast-paced hardware development and EVT/DVT/PVT environments.

job.title: Prototype Vehicle Technician
job.description:
Prototype Vehicle Technician

The Prototype Vehicle Technician supports engineering development and testing by maintaining, upgrading, and modifying test vehicles. This role performs component removal and replacement, interprets wiring and harness diagrams, follows engineering instructions, and uses Linux and basic shell scripts to support vehicle setup and troubleshooting.

What you’ll be able to do: 
  • Perform vehicle component removal and replacement (R&R) to support engineering development and testing.
  • Install and modify mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems according to engineering instructions.
  • Read and interpret wiring diagrams, harness schematics, connector pinouts, and technical procedures.
  • Safely operate hand tools, power tools, diagnostic equipment, and garage machinery.
  • Assist with basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, reporting findings to engineers.
  • Use Linux systems and run basic shell scripts for vehicle setup and diagnostics.
  • Document completed work, configuration changes, and identified issues.
  • Maintain an organized, safe workspace and comply with all garage procedures.
  • Adapt to changing priorities while working independently and collaborating with engineering teams.
  • Ability to track work through Jira and other Atlassian tools.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of electrical principles and automotive standards.

Minimum requirements: 
(one or more of the following)
  • Degree or Certification in Automotive Technology
  • 2+ years of experience as an Automotive Technician 
  • 2+ year of experience in a factory setting launching new products

Preferred Qualifications: 
  • Hands-on experience building and launching automotive products and vehicle prototyping  
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Confluence, and Jira applications 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • An eagerness to work in a fast paced cross-functional environment
  • Understanding of high voltage safety practices and demonstrated capability to work in a high voltage environment
  • Ability to travel and work flexible hours as needed to support road trips, test facilities, and proving ground activities.

job.title: Technical Program Manager – Chassis Firmware Integration
job.description:
Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
 
As Technical Program Manager, you will use your technical expertise to holistically drive complex problems to completion. You will work with the team to scope work, plan requirements, identify risks, estimate budgets, and clearly communicate ongoing progress.
Seeking an experienced Software Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Powertrain and Motion Controls. The TPM will be responsible for driving the team to meet their committed deliverables as well as working with the engineers, technical leads, and managers across the broader organization to assess risk, communicate status, and drive closure to key issues. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in automotive powertrain systems and motion controls, excellent project management skills, and experience working with highly cross-functional teams. This environment is not for everyone but will enrich the best talent with the opportunity to perform some of the best work of their careers. 

Responsibilities:
As a technical program manager, you will be a force multiplier and enable a world-class team of engineers to execute with quality and under aggressive development timelines.
You will be responsible for the following domains: powertrain and motion controls.
Your responsibilities include the following:
  • Coordinate with various controls, systems, and integration engineers to establish feature delivery roadmaps, define key deliverable delivery dates, and tie deliverables to engineering milestones.
  • Work Right-to-Left to ensure that the vehicle and motor torque controls development plans meet end-user needs, support hardware and system DV test plans, and meet engineering program milestones.
  • Coordinate with vehicle program management on prototype vehicle and test asset allocation. Ensure engineers have the resources that they need, at the time that they need it, to complete their testing and validation.
  • Run sprint planning sessions and help organize the engineering task workflow.
  • Track sprint action items and progress towards engineering deliverables. Report status to engineering management and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Work with engineering management to assess team workload management and vocalize resource gaps.
  • Assist engineering to prioritize work tasks and ensure team progress.
  • Set the overall sprint timeline, identify and resolve roadblocks.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years program management experience, with focus on automotive powertrain systems software development, verification and validation, or quality assurance
  • Product launch experience with a vehicle OEM in systems, software, or testing
  • Experience with automotive powertrain systems is required
  • Experience working with vehicle motion controls
  • Experience working with vehicle diagnostics
  • Experience with Agile Methodology, CI/CD is required
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

job.title: Contract Manufacturing Tech (Semiconductor)
job.description:
We have long-term contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $23.00 to $25.00/Hr.
Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.

  • Electronic Measurement Devices

  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials

  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

If you don't wish to receive these mails, just turn off "Job expiry email alerts" inside the user profile or system settings.

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
